Beings reviled Indra [saying]: 'He slew the three-headed one, the son of Tvaṣṭṛ; he gave the yatis to the wolves; he slew the arurmukhans; he stole back from Bṛhaspati; he broke the agreement and cut off the head of Namuci the asura' — for these divine offenses (devakilbiṣa). He wandered in the forest, not approaching the gods. He said to the gods: 'Sacrifice for me.' 'No,' they said. 'You have broken these agreements, you have committed these divine offenses; we shall not sacrifice for you.' But Agni was, as it were, his closest friend among the gods. He said to Agni: 'You sacrifice for me.' 'So be it,' he said. 'But I seek among the gods one with whom I may sacrifice for you.' He did not find among the gods one with whom he could sacrifice for him. He said: 'I cannot find among the gods one with whom I might sacrifice for you.' 'Then you yourself sacrifice for me.' 'So be it.' Agni extended this agniṣṭut from his own self. With it he sacrificed for him. Instantly it burned away all his evil. Just as a snake frees itself from its slough, just as one draws out an iṣīkā reed from muñja grass, so he freed himself from all evil. He who shines yonder, freed from evil — he is indeed Indra. He who is denounced, who is accused — he should sacrifice with this. Instantly it burns away all his evil.

2.133.s: sa yo mukhena pāpaṃ kṛtvā manyeta trivṛtāgniṣṭutā yajeta . eṣa ha vai mukhena pāpaṃ karoti yo 'vādyaṃ vadati . mukhaṃ vai trivṛt stomānām . mukhād eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate . atha yo bāhubhyāṃ pāpaṃ kṛtvā manyeta pañcadaśenāgniṣṭutā yajeta . eṣa ha vai bāhubhyāṃ pāpaṃ karoti yo 'nighātyasya nihanti . bāhū vai pañcadaśa stomānām . bāhubhyām eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate . atha udareṇa pāpaṃ kṛtvā manyeta saptadaśenāgniṣṭutāyajeta . eṣa ha vā udareṇa pāpaṃ karoti yo 'nāśyānnasyānnam atti . udaraṃ vai saptadaśa stomānām . udarād eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate . atha yaḥ padbhyām pāpaṃ kṛtvā manyeta ekaviṃśenāgniṣṭutā yajeta . eṣa ha vai padbhyāṃ pāpaṃ karoti yo janam eti . pratiṣṭhā vā ekaviṃśa stomānām . padbhyām eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate . atho āhur ya evāyaṃ jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomas tenaiva yajeteti . tasya yat trivṛd bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati mukhād eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate . atha yat pañcadaśāny ājyāni bhavanti pañcadaśo mādhyaṃdino bāhubhyāṃ eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate . atha yat saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni bhavanti saptadaśa ārbhava udarād eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate .
2.133.d: स यो मुखेन पापं कृत्वा मन्येत त्रिवृताग्निष्टुता यजेत . एष ह वै मुखेन पापं करोति यो ऽवाद्यं वदति . मुखं वै त्रिवृत् स्तोमानाम् . मुखाद् एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . अथ यो बाहुभ्यां पापं कृत्वा मन्येत पञ्चदशेनाग्निष्टुता यजेत . एष ह वै बाहुभ्यां पापं करोति यो ऽनिघात्यस्य निहन्ति . बाहू वै पञ्चदश स्तोमानाम् . बाहुभ्याम् एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . अथ उदरेण पापं कृत्वा मन्येत सप्तदशेनाग्निष्टुतायजेत . एष ह वा उदरेण पापं करोति यो ऽनाश्यान्नस्यान्नम् अत्ति . उदरं वै सप्तदश स्तोमानाम् . उदराद् एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . अथ यः पद्भ्याम् पापं कृत्वा मन्येत एकविंशेनाग्निष्टुता यजेत . एष ह वै पद्भ्यां पापं करोति यो जनम् एति . प्रतिष्ठा वा एकविंश स्तोमानाम् . पद्भ्याम् एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . अथो आहुर् य एवायं ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमस् तेनैव यजेतेति . तस्य यत् त्रिवृद् बहिष्पवमानं भवति मुखाद् एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . अथ यत् पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि भवन्ति पञ्चदशो माध्यंदिनो बाहुभ्यां एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . अथ यत् सप्तदशानि पृष्ठानि भवन्ति सप्तदश आर्भव उदराद् एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते .
2.133.m: He who thinks he has done evil with his mouth should sacrifice with the trivṛt agniṣṭut. He indeed does evil with his mouth who speaks what should not be spoken. The trivṛt is the mouth of the stomas. From the mouth he thereby drives away evil. He who thinks he has done evil with his arms should sacrifice with the pañcadaśa agniṣṭut. He indeed does evil with his arms who strikes one who should not be struck. The pañcadaśa is the arms of the stomas. From the arms he thereby drives away evil. He who thinks he has done evil with his belly should sacrifice with the saptadaśa agniṣṭut. He indeed does evil with his belly who eats the food of one whose food should not be eaten. The saptadaśa is the belly of the stomas. From the belly he thereby drives away evil. He who thinks he has done evil with his feet should sacrifice with the ekaviṃśa agniṣṭut. He indeed does evil with his feet who goes among people [with ill intent]. The ekaviṃśa is the foundation (feet) of the stomas. From the feet he thereby drives away evil. But they say: 'One should sacrifice with the very jyotiṣṭoma agniṣṭoma.' Of it, the trivṛt bahiṣpavamāna — from the mouth he thereby drives away evil. The pañcadaśa ājyas and the pañcadaśa midday — from the arms he thereby drives away evil. The saptadaśa pṛṣṭhas and the saptadaśa ārbhava — from the belly he thereby drives away evil.

2.134.s: trivṛtā tejaskāmo brahmavarcasakāmo 'gniṣṭutā yajeta pañcadaśena vīryakāmas saptadaśena paśukāmaḥ prajananakāma ekaviṃśena pratiṣṭhākāmas triṇavenaujaskāmas trayastriṃśena śrīkāmaḥ . tad u vā āhur vadanam evaitat sarvaṃ ya evāyaṃ catuṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomaḥ . tenaiva yajeteti . ayaṃ vai trivṛd ayaṃ pañcadaśo 'yaṃ saptadaśo 'yam ekaviṃśaḥ . imān vai prāṇān agnir anvāyattaḥ . sa yo 'nūcānas san na viroceta sa etena yajeteti . yathā ha vai niṣkaś śamalagṛhīta evaṃ sa yo 'nūcānas san na virocate . agnā u vā etaṃ prāsyanti yam agniṣṭutā yājayanti . tad yathā niṣkaṃ śamalagṛhītam agnau prāsya tasyāyoghanena sarvaṃ śamalaṃ nirhanyād evaṃ haivāsya sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ nirghnanti . so 'pahatapāpmā tejasvī brahmavarcasī bhavati . atho āhur yasminn eva paśavye sati paśavo na rameran sa enena yajeteti . yathā ha vai jaratkaṣa evaṃ sa yasmin paśavye sati paśavo na ramante . tasya revatīṣv agniṣṭomasāma bhavati . āpo vai revatayaḥ .
2.134.d: त्रिवृता तेजस्कामो ब्रह्मवर्चसकामो ऽग्निष्टुता यजेत पञ्चदशेन वीर्यकामस् सप्तदशेन पशुकामः प्रजननकाम एकविंशेन प्रतिष्ठाकामस् त्रिणवेनौजस्कामस् त्रयस्त्रिंशेन श्रीकामः . तद् उ वा आहुर् वदनम् एवैतत् सर्वं य एवायं चतुष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमः . तेनैव यजेतेति . अयं वै त्रिवृद् अयं पञ्चदशो ऽयं सप्तदशो ऽयम् एकविंशः . इमान् वै प्राणान् अग्निर् अन्वायत्तः . स यो ऽनूचानस् सन् न विरोचेत स एतेन यजेतेति . यथा ह वै निष्कश् शमलगृहीत एवं स यो ऽनूचानस् सन् न विरोचते . अग्ना उ वा एतं प्रास्यन्ति यम् अग्निष्टुता याजयन्ति . तद् यथा निष्कं शमलगृहीतम् अग्नौ प्रास्य तस्यायोघनेन सर्वं शमलं निर्हन्याद् एवं हैवास्य सर्वं पाप्मानं निर्घ्नन्ति . सो ऽपहतपाप्मा तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति . अथो आहुर् यस्मिन्न् एव पशव्ये सति पशवो न रमेरन् स एनेन यजेतेति . यथा ह वै जरत्कष एवं स यस्मिन् पशव्ये सति पशवो न रमन्ते . तस्य रेवतीष्व् अग्निष्टोमसाम भवति . आपो वै रेवतयः .
2.134.m: He who desires tejas (radiance) and brahmavarcas should sacrifice with the trivṛt agniṣṭut; he who desires strength with the pañcadaśa; he who desires cattle, desiring offspring, with the saptadaśa; he who desires a firm foundation with the ekaviṃśa; he who desires vigour with the triṇava; he who desires glory with the trayastriṃśa. But they say this is all mere talk; one should sacrifice with the very catuṣṭoma agniṣṭoma: 'This is the trivṛt, this the pañcadaśa, this the saptadaśa, this the ekaviṃśa. Agni is dependent on these prāṇas.' He who, being learned, does not shine forth — he should sacrifice with this. Just as a gold ornament (niṣka) tarnished with impurity, so is he who, being learned, does not shine forth. They cast him, as it were, into Agni when they make him sacrifice with the agniṣṭut. Just as one, having cast a tarnished gold ornament into fire, would hammer out all its impurity with a hammer — so they strike out all his evil. He becomes freed from evil, radiant, and full of brahmavarcas. And they say: 'He in whose cattle-pen, though it exists, cattle do not stay — he should sacrifice with this.' For he is, as it were, a dried-up thicket — one in whose cattle-pen cattle do not stay. The agniṣṭoma-sāman is set to the revatī verses. The revatīs are the waters.

2.135.s: tad yathā jaratkakṣam agninopadīpya tam adbhir upasiñcet tasmin kalyāṇya oṣadhayo jāyeraṃs tāsu paśavo ramerann evaṃ haivāsmin sarve paśavo ramante . tasy āgna āyūṃṣi pavasa ity eṣāgnipāvamānī pratipad bhavati . tad āhur vīva vā etaiḥ prāṇair ṛdhyante ye pāvamānībhiḥ pratipadyanta iti . tad yad eṣāgnipāvamānī pratipad bhavatīti prāṇo vai vāyuḥ prāṇair eva tat samṛdhyante . agne pāvaka rociṣe ty annaṃ vai pāvakam annādyenaivainaṃ tat samardhayanti . atho vāyur vai pāvakaḥ prāṇo vai vāyur abhipūrvam evainaṃ tat prāṇais samardhayanti . agniś śucivratatama ity aśucir iva vā eṣa bhavati yo 'bhyākhyāyate . śucim evainam etena pūtaṃ medhyaṃ kurvanti . tasya yajñāyajñā vo 'gnaya ity etā mādhyaṃdinasya pavamānasya bṛhatyo bhavanti . agnā u vā etaṃ prāsyanti yam agniṣṭutā yājayanti . uta trātā tanūnām ity agnaya eva tad vaiśvānarāya yajamānas tanvaṃ paridatte . tasya pāhi no agna ekaye ty etāsu nārmedhasyarkṣu rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati . etābhir vai nṛmedhā auśijo 'gner harāṃsy apairayata . agner evaitābhir harāṃsy aperayate . tasya śaṃ no devīr abhiṣṭaya ity etāsv aponaptriyāsv agniṣṭomasāma bhavati . āpo vā aponaptriyaḥ .
2.135.d: तद् यथा जरत्कक्षम् अग्निनोपदीप्य तम् अद्भिर् उपसिञ्चेत् तस्मिन् कल्याण्य ओषधयो जायेरंस् तासु पशवो रमेरन्न् एवं हैवास्मिन् सर्वे पशवो रमन्ते . तस्य् आग्न आयूंषि पवस इत्य् एषाग्निपावमानी प्रतिपद् भवति . तद् आहुर् वीव वा एतैः प्राणैर् ऋध्यन्ते ये पावमानीभिः प्रतिपद्यन्त इति . तद् यद् एषाग्निपावमानी प्रतिपद् भवतीति प्राणो वै वायुः प्राणैर् एव तत् समृध्यन्ते . अग्ने पावक रोचिषे त्य् अन्नं वै पावकम् अन्नाद्येनैवैनं तत् समर्धयन्ति . अथो वायुर् वै पावकः प्राणो वै वायुर् अभिपूर्वम् एवैनं तत् प्राणैस् समर्धयन्ति . अग्निश् शुचिव्रततम इत्य् अशुचिर् इव वा एष भवति यो ऽभ्याख्यायते . शुचिम् एवैनम् एतेन पूतं मेध्यं कुर्वन्ति . तस्य यज्ञायज्ञा वो ऽग्नय इत्य् एता माध्यंदिनस्य पवमानस्य बृहत्यो भवन्ति . अग्ना उ वा एतं प्रास्यन्ति यम् अग्निष्टुता याजयन्ति . उत त्राता तनूनाम् इत्य् अग्नय एव तद् वैश्वानराय यजमानस् तन्वं परिदत्ते . तस्य पाहि नो अग्न एकये त्य् एतासु नार्मेधस्यर्क्षु रथन्तरं पृष्ठं भवति . एताभिर् वै नृमेधा औशिजो ऽग्नेर् हरांस्य् अपैरयत . अग्नेर् एवैताभिर् हरांस्य् अपेरयते . तस्य शं नो देवीर् अभिष्टय इत्य् एतास्व् अपोनप्त्रियास्व् अग्निष्टोमसाम भवति . आपो वा अपोनप्त्रियः .
2.135.m: Just as, having set fire to a dried-up thicket, one would sprinkle it with water, and in it good plants would grow, and in them cattle would stay — so indeed all cattle come to stay with him. Its opening verse (pratipad) of the Agni-pavamāna is 'O Agni, you purify our lives' (agna āyūṃṣi pavase). They say: 'Those who begin with pāvamānī verses are indeed well-endowed with prāṇas.' Because this is the Agni-pāvamānī opening — prāṇa is indeed Vāyu — they are thereby enriched with prāṇas. 'O Agni Pāvaka, you shine' (agne pāvaka rociṣe) — pāvaka is food; they thereby endow him with food. Or, Vāyu is pāvaka; prāṇa is Vāyu — they thereby endow him progressively with prāṇas. 'O Agni, of most pure observance' (agniś śucivratatama) — for he who is accused is, as it were, impure; by this they make him pure, cleansed, and fit for sacrifice. The bṛhatīs of the midday pavamāna are 'O fires of sacrifice upon sacrifice' (yajñāyajñā vo agnaye). They cast him, as it were, into Agni when they make him sacrifice with the agniṣṭut. 'And protector of our bodies' (uta trātā tanūnām) — by this the sacrificer entrusts his body to Agni Vaiśvānara. The rathantara pṛṣṭha is set to the verses of Nṛmedha, son of Uśij: 'Protect us, O Agni, with a single [defense]' (pāhi no agna ekayā). With these [verses] Nṛmedha Auśija drove away the fiery missiles of Agni; with these one drives away the fiery missiles of Agni. The agniṣṭoma-sāman is set to the āponaptrīya verses: 'May the divine [waters] be for our welfare' (śaṃ no devīr abhiṣṭaye). The āponaptrīya verses belong to the waters.

2.136.s: tad yathāgnidagdham adbhir abhiṣiñcet tādṛg eva tac chāntyai . tad āhur yo vā agnidagdham adbhir abhiṣiñcati bhūyo vaitat pramṛcyati kilāsaṃ  vā bhavati . ā no yajñaṃ divispṛśaṃ vāyo yāhi sumanmabhir ity etāsv eva vāyumatīṣu kāryaṃ vāyur vai śāntiś śāntyā evānirdāhāyeti . tad āhur yo vā āgnīn upadīpya vātenopavājayati bhūyo vai tad dīpyate . dīptir vāvaiṣeti . tad u vā āhus tad vāva yajamāna icched yat sa dīpyeta . yad u dīptyai vāyur eva dīptyai . yad u śāntyai vāyur eva śāntyai . tasmād etāsv eva vāyumatīṣu kāryam iti . tasyājā ca hiraṇyaṃ ca dakṣiṇā . āgneyī vā ajāgneyaṃ hiraṇyam . atho āhur anaḍvān dakṣiṇeti . vahati vā anaḍvān vahaty agnir devebhyo haviḥ .
2.136.d: तद् यथाग्निदग्धम् अद्भिर् अभिषिञ्चेत् तादृग् एव तच् छान्त्यै . तद् आहुर् यो वा अग्निदग्धम् अद्भिर् अभिषिञ्चति भूयो वैतत् प्रमृच्यति किलासं  वा भवति . आ नो यज्ञं दिविस्पृशं वायो याहि सुमन्मभिर् इत्य् एतास्व् एव वायुमतीषु कार्यं वायुर् वै शान्तिश् शान्त्या एवानिर्दाहायेति . तद् आहुर् यो वा आग्नीन् उपदीप्य वातेनोपवाजयति भूयो वै तद् दीप्यते . दीप्तिर् वावैषेति . तद् उ वा आहुस् तद् वाव यजमान इच्छेद् यत् स दीप्येत . यद् उ दीप्त्यै वायुर् एव दीप्त्यै . यद् उ शान्त्यै वायुर् एव शान्त्यै . तस्माद् एतास्व् एव वायुमतीषु कार्यम् इति . तस्याजा च हिरण्यं च दक्षिणा . आग्नेयी वा अजाग्नेयं हिरण्यम् . अथो आहुर् अनड्वान् दक्षिणेति . वहति वा अनड्वान् वहत्य् अग्निर् देवेभ्यो हविः .
2.136.m: Just as one would sprinkle water on what has been burnt by fire — such is this, for the sake of pacification. They say: 'He who sprinkles water on what has been burnt by fire — thereby he afflicts it further; it becomes kilāsa (a skin disease).' 'O Vāyu, come to our sacrifice reaching heaven, with good thoughts' (ā no yajñaṃ divispṛśam vāyo yāhi sumanmabhiḥ) — it should be done in these Vāyu-verses, for Vāyu is peace, for the sake of peace, to avoid [further] burning.' They say: 'He who, having kindled fires, fans them with wind — it burns all the more; this is [just more] blazing.' But they also say: 'The sacrificer would indeed desire that he should blaze forth. Whether for blazing, Vāyu serves for blazing; whether for peace, Vāyu serves for peace. Therefore it should be done in these Vāyu-verses.' The dakṣiṇā for this is a she-goat and gold. A she-goat belongs to Agni; gold belongs to Agni. And they say: 'A bull (anaḍvān) is the dakṣiṇā.' For a bull carries, and Agni carries the oblation for the gods.

2.137.s: athaiṣa indrastomaḥ . indro vā akāmayata sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ gaccheyam iti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato vai sa sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭhatām agacchat . gacchati svānāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ ya evaṃ veda . indre ha vā agre yajña āsa . śrīr ha vā asmiṃs tad āsa . yajña u ha vāva devānāṃ śrīḥ . tam u ha vṛtro 'bhivavṛdhe . sa devān upādhāvad yuṣmābhir balenemaṃ vṛtraṃ hanānīti . tam abruvan sa vai no yas te 'yaṃ niṣkevalyo yajñas taṃ prayaccheti . tasmād rājani vijigīṣamāṇe viṣaḥ pradānam icchante . tasmād u rājā vijigīṣamāṇo viśa eva pradānaṃ prayacchati . sa vasubhya eva prātassavanaṃ prāyacchad rudrebhyo mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam ādityebhyas tṛtīyasavanaṃ viśvebhyaś ca devebhyaḥ . tair balenendro vṛtram ahan . ajayan devā asurān . sa vṛtraṃ hatvā vijitya pṛthag evaiṣāṃ imā śriyo dīpyamānā apaśyat . tam abhiśastir avindan . sa aikṣata kathaṃ nv aham eṣām imā śriyas saṃvṛñjīyeti . sa etenaiva yajñenāyajata . tenaiṣāṃ sarvā śriyas samavṛṅkta .
2.137.d: अथैष इन्द्रस्तोमः . इन्द्रो वा अकामयत सर्वेषां देवानां श्रेष्ठतां गच्छेयम् इति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . ततो वै स सर्वेषां देवानां श्रेष्ठताम् अगच्छत् . गच्छति स्वानां श्रेष्ठतां य एवं वेद . इन्द्रे ह वा अग्रे यज्ञ आस . श्रीर् ह वा अस्मिंस् तद् आस . यज्ञ उ ह वाव देवानां श्रीः . तम् उ ह वृत्रो ऽभिववृधे . स देवान् उपाधावद् युष्माभिर् बलेनेमं वृत्रं हनानीति . तम् अब्रुवन् स वै नो यस् ते ऽयं निष्केवल्यो यज्ञस् तं प्रयच्छेति . तस्माद् राजनि विजिगीषमाणे विषः प्रदानम् इच्छन्ते . तस्माद् उ राजा विजिगीषमाणो विश एव प्रदानं प्रयच्छति . स वसुभ्य एव प्रातस्सवनं प्रायच्छद् रुद्रेभ्यो माध्यंदिनं सवनम् आदित्येभ्यस् तृतीयसवनं विश्वेभ्यश् च देवेभ्यः . तैर् बलेनेन्द्रो वृत्रम् अहन् . अजयन् देवा असुरान् . स वृत्रं हत्वा विजित्य पृथग् एवैषां इमा श्रियो दीप्यमाना अपश्यत् . तम् अभिशस्तिर् अविन्दन् . स ऐक्षत कथं न्व् अहम् एषाम् इमा श्रियस् संवृञ्जीयेति . स एतेनैव यज्ञेनायजत . तेनैषां सर्वा श्रियस् समवृङ्क्त .
2.137.m: Now this is the indrastoma. Indra desired: 'May I attain supremacy over all the gods.' He saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. Then he attained supremacy over all the gods. He attains supremacy over his own people who knows thus. The sacrifice was originally Indra's. Glory (śrī) was in it. For the sacrifice is indeed the glory of the gods. But Vṛtra overwhelmed him. He ran to the gods: 'With your strength I shall slay this Vṛtra.' They said: 'Give us that exclusive sacrifice (niṣkevalya) of yours.' Therefore, when a king wishes to conquer, the people (viś) seek a gift. And therefore the king who wishes to conquer gives a gift to the people. He gave the morning pressing to the Vasus, the midday pressing to the Rudras, the third pressing to the Ādityas and to all the gods. With their strength Indra slew Vṛtra. The gods conquered the asuras. Having slain Vṛtra and conquered, he saw these glories of theirs shining separately. Reproach came upon him. He considered: 'How might I gather these glories of theirs to myself?' He sacrificed with this very sacrifice. Thereby he gathered all their glories to himself.

2.138.s: sa aindrīṣv eva sarvo bhavati . aindrīṣv eva prātassavanaṃ bhavaty aindrīṣu mādhyaṃdianaṃ savanam aindrīṣu tṛtīyasavanam . tad yad gāyatraṃ sat prātassavanam aindrīṣu kriyate vasūnām eva tena yajñaṃ samavṛṅkta . atha yat traiṣṭubhaṃ san mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam aindrīṣu kriyate rudrāṇām eva tena yajñaṃ samavṛṅkta . atha yaj jāgataṃ sat tṛtīyasavanam aindrīṣu kriyata ādityānām eva tena yajñaṃ samavṛṅkta viśveṣāṃ ca devānām . ta enam āttayajñā upāsīdan viśas te 'sāma yajñe no 'nvābhajeti yathā bhartāraṃ bhāryā upasīdanti tathā . sa vasūn eva prātassavane 'nvābhajad rudrān mādhyaṃdine savana ādityāṃs tṛtīyasavane viśvāṃś ca devān . yathā rājā vijitya sve vitte bhāryān anvābhajed evam evaināṃs tad anvābhajat . tasmād indrāya vasumate rudravata ādityavate viśvadevyāvata ity anvāhus . sa pañcadaśo bhavati . vajro vai pañcadaśaḥ . vajra indraḥ . aindra eṣa yajñas tat tatsalakṣma kriyate . sa ukthyo bhavati . viḍ vā ukthāni . kṣatram eva tad viśy adhyūhanti . tasmāt kṣatriyo viśy adhyūḍhaḥ . saya śrīkāma syāt sa etena yajeta .
2.138.d: स ऐन्द्रीष्व् एव सर्वो भवति . ऐन्द्रीष्व् एव प्रातस्सवनं भवत्य् ऐन्द्रीषु माध्यंदिअनं सवनम् ऐन्द्रीषु तृतीयसवनम् . तद् यद् गायत्रं सत् प्रातस्सवनम् ऐन्द्रीषु क्रियते वसूनाम् एव तेन यज्ञं समवृङ्क्त . अथ यत् त्रैष्टुभं सन् माध्यंदिनं सवनम् ऐन्द्रीषु क्रियते रुद्राणाम् एव तेन यज्ञं समवृङ्क्त . अथ यज् जागतं सत् तृतीयसवनम् ऐन्द्रीषु क्रियत आदित्यानाम् एव तेन यज्ञं समवृङ्क्त विश्वेषां च देवानाम् . त एनम् आत्तयज्ञा उपासीदन् विशस् ते ऽसाम यज्ञे नो ऽन्वाभजेति यथा भर्तारं भार्या उपसीदन्ति तथा . स वसून् एव प्रातस्सवने ऽन्वाभजद् रुद्रान् माध्यंदिने सवन आदित्यांस् तृतीयसवने विश्वांश् च देवान् . यथा राजा विजित्य स्वे वित्ते भार्यान् अन्वाभजेद् एवम् एवैनांस् तद् अन्वाभजत् . तस्माद् इन्द्राय वसुमते रुद्रवत आदित्यवते विश्वदेव्यावत इत्य् अन्वाहुस् . स पञ्चदशो भवति . वज्रो वै पञ्चदशः . वज्र इन्द्रः . ऐन्द्र एष यज्ञस् तत् तत्सलक्ष्म क्रियते . स उक्थ्यो भवति . विड् वा उक्थानि . क्षत्रम् एव तद् विश्य् अध्यूहन्ति . तस्मात् क्षत्रियो विश्य् अध्यूढः . सय श्रीकाम स्यात् स एतेन यजेत .
2.138.m: It is entirely in aindrī (Indra-related) [verses]. The morning pressing is in aindrī [verses], the midday pressing is in aindrī [verses], the third pressing is in aindrī [verses]. Because the morning pressing, though gāyatra in form, is done in aindrī verses — thereby he gathered to himself the sacrifice of the Vasus. Because the midday pressing, though traiṣṭubha in form, is done in aindrī verses — thereby he gathered to himself the sacrifice of the Rudras. Because the third pressing, though jāgata in form, is done in aindrī verses — thereby he gathered to himself the sacrifice of the Ādityas and all the gods. They, their sacrifice taken away, approached him [saying]: 'We are your people (viś); give us a share in the sacrifice' — as wives approach a husband. He gave the Vasus a share at the morning pressing, the Rudras at the midday pressing, the Ādityas at the third pressing, and all the gods. Just as a king, having conquered, would give his dependents a share in his wealth, so he gave them a share. Therefore they recite: 'To Indra, accompanied by the Vasus, by the Rudras, by the Ādityas, by the Viśvedevas.' It is pañcadaśa (fifteenfold). The vajra (thunderbolt) is the pañcadaśa; the vajra is Indra. This sacrifice belongs to Indra; therefore it is made to bear his mark. It is ukthya. The ukthāni are the viś (people). Kṣatra is thus placed upon the viś. Therefore the kṣatriya is placed above the viś. He who desires glory (śrī) should sacrifice with this.

2.139.s: athaiṣa vighanaḥ . prajāpatir devān asṛjata vasūn rudrān ādityān . tebhyo yajñaṃ cemāṃś ca lokān prāyacchat . vasubhya eva prātassavanaṃ prāyacchad rudrebhyo mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam ādityebhyas tṛtīyasavanam . vasubhya evemaṃ lokaṃ prāyacchad rudrebhyo 'ntarikṣam ādityebhyo 'mum . athendram asṛjata . sa idam eṣāṃ sarvam vibhaktam apaśyat . so 'bravīd yad idam eṣāṃ sarvaṃ vibhaktam atha kasmai mām asṛṣṭhā iti . eteṣāṃ tvā ity abravīc chraiṣṭhyāyādhipatyāyāsṛkṣīti . so 'haṃ katham eṣāṃ śreṣṭho 'dhipati syām iti . parehy enān brūhīty abravīd yuṣmākaṃ mā prajāpati śraiṣṭhyāyādhipatyāyāsṛṣṭeti . sa etyābravīd yuṣmākaṃ mā prajāpati śraiṣṭhyāyādhipatyāyāsṛṣṭeti . te 'bruvan vayaṃ vāva śreṣṭhā smo vayam adhipatayo ye jyeṣṭhā sma iti nājānan . sa punar etyābravīn na vā amī taj jānanti yat tvam āttheti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenainam ayājayat . sa heṣṭvaiva sarvā mṛdho vyahata . yad vyahata tad vighanasya vighanatvam .
2.139.d: अथैष विघनः . प्रजापतिर् देवान् असृजत वसून् रुद्रान् आदित्यान् . तेभ्यो यज्ञं चेमांश् च लोकान् प्रायच्छत् . वसुभ्य एव प्रातस्सवनं प्रायच्छद् रुद्रेभ्यो माध्यंदिनं सवनम् आदित्येभ्यस् तृतीयसवनम् . वसुभ्य एवेमं लोकं प्रायच्छद् रुद्रेभ्यो ऽन्तरिक्षम् आदित्येभ्यो ऽमुम् . अथेन्द्रम् असृजत . स इदम् एषां सर्वम् विभक्तम् अपश्यत् . सो ऽब्रवीद् यद् इदम् एषां सर्वं विभक्तम् अथ कस्मै माम् असृष्ठा इति . एतेषां त्वा इत्य् अब्रवीच् छ्रैष्ठ्यायाधिपत्यायासृक्षीति . सो ऽहं कथम् एषां श्रेष्ठो ऽधिपति स्याम् इति . परेह्य् एनान् ब्रूहीत्य् अब्रवीद् युष्माकं मा प्रजापति श्रैष्ठ्यायाधिपत्यायासृष्टेति . स एत्याब्रवीद् युष्माकं मा प्रजापति श्रैष्ठ्यायाधिपत्यायासृष्टेति . ते ऽब्रुवन् वयं वाव श्रेष्ठा स्मो वयम् अधिपतयो ये ज्येष्ठा स्म इति नाजानन् . स पुनर् एत्याब्रवीन् न वा अमी तज् जानन्ति यत् त्वम् आत्थेति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनैनम् अयाजयत् . स हेष्ट्वैव सर्वा मृधो व्यहत . यद् व्यहत तद् विघनस्य विघनत्वम् .
2.139.m: Now this is the vighana (striking down). Prajāpati created the gods — the Vasus, the Rudras, and the Ādityas. He gave them the sacrifice and these worlds. To the Vasus he gave the morning pressing; to the Rudras the midday pressing; to the Ādityas the third pressing. To the Vasus he gave this world; to the Rudras the atmosphere; to the Ādityas the world beyond. Then he created Indra. He (Indra) saw that all this of theirs had been distributed. He said: 'Since all this of theirs has been distributed, for what purpose did you create me?' 'I created you for supremacy and sovereignty over these,' he said. 'How then shall I be their chief and sovereign?' 'Go and tell them: Prajāpati created me for supremacy and sovereignty over you.' He went and said: 'Prajāpati created me for supremacy and sovereignty over you.' They said: 'We are the chiefs, we are the sovereigns, we who are the eldest' — they did not acknowledge him. He returned and said: 'They do not acknowledge what you say.' He (Prajāpati) saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He made him sacrifice with it. Having sacrificed, he struck down all opposition. Because he struck down (vyahata), that is the vighana-ness of the vighana.

2.140.s: taṃ vijigyānaṃ sarve devā abhitas samantaṃ paryaviśan vasavaḥ purastād rudrā dakṣiṇata ādityāḥ paścān maruta uttarato viśve devā upariṣṭāt sādhyāś cāptyāś cāhdastād abhito 'ṅgirasaḥ . eṣā vai daivī śrīr daivā sabhā daivī saṃsat . gacchati ha vā etāṃ daivīṃ śriyaṃ daivīṃsabhāṃ daivīṃ saṃsadaṃ ya evaṃ veda . sa vā eṣa ṣaḍ bṛhatīr abhisaṃpadyate . ṣaḍ vā ṛtavas saṃvatsaraśrīḥ . śriyāṃ vāvainaṃ tad adhyauhat . sa eṣa ṛtuṣu ca saṃvatsare caitasyāṃ śriyām adhyūḍhas tapati . tasya pratnaṃ pīyūṣaṃ pūrvaṃ yad ukthyam ity etāḥ satobṛhatayo bhavanti gāyatrībhājanam . brahma vai gāyatrī . kṣatraṃ bṛhatī . brahmaiva tad yaśasānakti .
2.140.d: तं विजिग्यानं सर्वे देवा अभितस् समन्तं पर्यविशन् वसवः पुरस्ताद् रुद्रा दक्षिणत आदित्याः पश्चान् मरुत उत्तरतो विश्वे देवा उपरिष्टात् साध्याश् चाप्त्याश् चाह्दस्ताद् अभितो ऽङ्गिरसः . एषा वै दैवी श्रीर् दैवा सभा दैवी संसत् . गच्छति ह वा एतां दैवीं श्रियं दैवींसभां दैवीं संसदं य एवं वेद . स वा एष षड् बृहतीर् अभिसंपद्यते . षड् वा ऋतवस् संवत्सरश्रीः . श्रियां वावैनं तद् अध्यौहत् . स एष ऋतुषु च संवत्सरे चैतस्यां श्रियाम् अध्यूढस् तपति . तस्य प्रत्नं पीयूषं पूर्वं यद् उक्थ्यम् इत्य् एताः सतोबृहतयो भवन्ति गायत्रीभाजनम् . ब्रह्म वै गायत्री . क्षत्रं बृहती . ब्रह्मैव तद् यशसानक्ति .
2.140.m: Him, the conqueror, all the gods surrounded on every side: the Vasus from the east, the Rudras from the south, the Ādityas from the west, the Maruts from the north, the Viśvedevas from above, the Sādhyas and the Āptyas from below, and the Aṅgirasas on both sides. This is the divine glory (śrī), the divine assembly (sabhā), the divine council (saṃsat). He who knows thus attains this divine glory, divine assembly, and divine council. This amounts to six bṛhatīs. Six are the seasons; the year is glory. He was thus elevated into glory. He who shines yonder is elevated in the seasons, in the year, in this glory. The satobṛhatī verses are 'His ancient essence, the first, which is ukthya' (pratnaṃ pīyūṣaṃ pūrvaṃ yad ukthyam) — they serve as the gāyatrī portion. Brahman is the gāyatrī; kṣatra is the bṛhatī. He thereby anoints brahman with glory.

2.141.s: tāsu vyatiṣaktāsu stuvanti vyatiṣaktād vai mithunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante prajātyā eva . atho vyatiṣakto vai puruṣaḥ pāpmabhiḥ . vyatiṣaktābhir eva tad vyatiṣaktān pāpmano 'pahate . tāsu gāyatram uktabrāhmaṇam . athāmahīyavam uktabrāhmaṇam . atha sauparṇam uktabrāhmaṇam . atha satrāsāhīyaṃ vijityai . satrā tam abhiṣahātai yo 'syābhiṣahyo 'sad iti . athotsedhaniṣedhau pāpavasyasasyaivotsiddhyai ca niṣiddhyai ca . atha viśoviśīyaṃ ca sadoviśīyaṃ ca . viśoviśīyena vā indro devān abhyārohat . tān sadoviśam ity eva sadoviśīyena viśam akuruta . athaitās triṣṭubho bhavanti . tāsu brahmasāma . brahma vai brahmasāma . kṣatraṃ triṣṭup . yajamānakāmo vā eṣa yad brahmasāma .
2.141.d: तासु व्यतिषक्तासु स्तुवन्ति व्यतिषक्ताद् वै मिथुनात् प्रजाः पशवः प्रजायन्ते प्रजात्या एव . अथो व्यतिषक्तो वै पुरुषः पाप्मभिः . व्यतिषक्ताभिर् एव तद् व्यतिषक्तान् पाप्मनो ऽपहते . तासु गायत्रम् उक्तब्राह्मणम् . अथामहीयवम् उक्तब्राह्मणम् . अथ सौपर्णम् उक्तब्राह्मणम् . अथ सत्रासाहीयं विजित्यै . सत्रा तम् अभिषहातै यो ऽस्याभिषह्यो ऽसद् इति . अथोत्सेधनिषेधौ पापवस्यसस्यैवोत्सिद्ध्यै च निषिद्ध्यै च . अथ विशोविशीयं च सदोविशीयं च . विशोविशीयेन वा इन्द्रो देवान् अभ्यारोहत् . तान् सदोविशम् इत्य् एव सदोविशीयेन विशम् अकुरुत . अथैतास् त्रिष्टुभो भवन्ति . तासु ब्रह्मसाम . ब्रह्म वै ब्रह्मसाम . क्षत्रं त्रिष्टुप् . यजमानकामो वा एष यद् ब्रह्मसाम .
2.141.m: They chant in interwoven fashion — from an interwoven coupling offspring and cattle are born, for the sake of procreation. Moreover, a person is interwoven with evils; with interwoven [chants] one drives away the interwoven evils. Among them, the gāyatra, with its brāhmaṇa stated. Then the amahīyava, with its brāhmaṇa stated. Then the sauparṇa, with its brāhmaṇa stated. Then the satrāsāhīya — for conquest; may he completely overpower whoever would be his adversary. Then the utsedha and niṣedha — for the repelling and suppressing of evil fortune. Then the viśoviśīya and the sadoviśīya. By the viśoviśīya Indra rose above the gods. By the sadoviśīya he made them sit together in the assembly (sadoviśam), making them his subjects. Then there are triṣṭubh [verses]. Among them is the brahmasāman. Brahman is the brahmasāman; kṣatra is the triṣṭubh. The brahmasāman is the wish of the sacrificer.

2.142.s: tāḥ padabrāhmaṇā bhavanti . tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham iti prajāpatir hi saḥ . prajāpatir hy eṣa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaḥ . yato jajña ugras tveṣanṛmṇa iti indro ha saḥ . sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūn iti sadyo hy eva sa jajñānas sarvā mṛdho vyahata . anu yaṃ viśve madanty ūmā ity ṛtavo vā ūmās ta evainaṃ tad anumadanti . vāvṛdhānaś śavasā bhūryojāś śatrur dāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhātī tīndro ha saḥ . avyanaś ca vyanaś ca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣv iti yac ca ha vai vyaniti yac ca na tat sarvam etasyaiva śriyai tat sthānam . tve kratum vṛñjanti viśve dvir yad ete trir bhavanty ūmā iti ṛtavo vā ūmās ta evaite dvis trir bhavanti . svādo svādīya svādunā sṛjā sam iti prajā vai svāduḥ prajāyai yā prajā sā svādo svādu . adaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīr iti prajā vai madhu prajāyai yā prajā sā madhor madhu . api ha prajāyai prajāṃ paśyate ya evaṃ veda .
2.142.d: ताः पदब्राह्मणा भवन्ति . तद् इद् आस भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठम् इति प्रजापतिर् हि सः . प्रजापतिर् ह्य् एष भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठः . यतो जज्ञ उग्रस् त्वेषनृम्ण इति इन्द्रो ह सः . सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रून् इति सद्यो ह्य् एव स जज्ञानस् सर्वा मृधो व्यहत . अनु यं विश्वे मदन्त्य् ऊमा इत्य् ऋतवो वा ऊमास् त एवैनं तद् अनुमदन्ति . वावृधानश् शवसा भूर्योजाश् शत्रुर् दासाय भियसं दधाती तीन्द्रो ह सः . अव्यनश् च व्यनश् च सस्नि सं ते नवन्त प्रभृता मदेष्व् इति यच् च ह वै व्यनिति यच् च न तत् सर्वम् एतस्यैव श्रियै तत् स्थानम् . त्वे क्रतुम् वृञ्जन्ति विश्वे द्विर् यद् एते त्रिर् भवन्त्य् ऊमा इति ऋतवो वा ऊमास् त एवैते द्विस् त्रिर् भवन्ति . स्वादो स्वादीय स्वादुना सृजा सम् इति प्रजा वै स्वादुः प्रजायै या प्रजा सा स्वादो स्वादु . अदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीर् इति प्रजा वै मधु प्रजायै या प्रजा सा मधोर् मधु . अपि ह प्रजायै प्रजां पश्यते य एवं वेद .
2.142.m: They have pada-brāhmaṇas (word-by-word explanations). 'That was the greatest among beings' (tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham) — that is Prajāpati, for Prajāpati is the greatest among beings. 'From whom was born the fierce one of terrifying strength' (yato jajña ugras tveṣanṛmṇaḥ) — that is Indra. 'As soon as born he destroys his enemies' (sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūn) — for as soon as he was born he struck down all opposition. 'Whom all the seasons gladly praise' (anu yaṃ viśve madanty ūmāḥ) — the ūmās are the seasons; they praise him. 'Growing great in strength, of mighty vigour, he puts fear into the enemy' (vāvṛdhānaś śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrur dāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti) — that is Indra. 'Both the unmoving and the moving yield to you; your praises flow forth in exhilaration' (avyanaś ca vyanaś ca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu) — whatever moves and what does not move, all that is the seat of his glory. 'In you they offer their resolves; twice and thrice come the seasons' (tve kratum api vṛñjanti viśve dvir yad ete trir bhavanty ūmāḥ) — the ūmās are the seasons; they come twice and thrice. 'O sweet one, mix the sweeter with the sweet' (svādo svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā sam) — offspring is the sweet; for the offspring that is offspring, that is 'the sweet of the sweet.' 'With that honey contend with honey' (adaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ) — offspring is honey; for the offspring that is offspring, that is 'honey of honey.' He who knows thus indeed sees offspring from offspring.

2.143.s: athaitāni gonāmāni bhavanti paśavo vai gonāmāni paśūnām evāvaruddhyai . ekapadā prathamā bhavati tripade uttare dve . tāni saptapadāni saṃpadyante . saptapadā vai śakvaryaḥ . śākvarāḥ paśavaḥ . abhipūrvāṇām eva paśūnām avaruddhyai . tad āhur apāvamānyo na pavamāne kāryā iti . tad u vā āhuḥ pāvamānya evāmuṣya vā etāś candramasa ṛcaḥ . eṣa vai pavamāna eṣa somo rājā . tasmāt kāryā eveti . sumanmā vasvī rantī sūnarī surūpa vṛṣann ā gahi imau bhadrau dhuryāv abhi tāv imā upasarpataḥ nīva śīrṣāṇi mṛḍhvaṃ madhya āpasya tiṣṭhati śṛṅgebhir daśabhir diśan iti ye ha vā eta ādityasya raśmaya etāni ha vā etasya śṛṅgāṇi . madhya u ha vā eṣa etad apām . tāsu vāravatīyam . yad anena karmaṇāvārutsmahi tan no vāravantīyena vāritam antata upatiṣṭhātā iti . tad u vā āhur yad vāvānyā vāṅ nātivadati tad etasyāhno 'gniṣṭomasāma kāryam . yajñāyajñīyaṃ vāvānyā vāṅ nātivadati . vāg vai yajñāyajñīyam . kuto hi vāg vācam ativadiṣyati .
2.143.d: अथैतानि गोनामानि भवन्ति पशवो वै गोनामानि पशूनाम् एवावरुद्ध्यै . एकपदा प्रथमा भवति त्रिपदे उत्तरे द्वे . तानि सप्तपदानि संपद्यन्ते . सप्तपदा वै शक्वर्यः . शाक्वराः पशवः . अभिपूर्वाणाम् एव पशूनाम् अवरुद्ध्यै . तद् आहुर् अपावमान्यो न पवमाने कार्या इति . तद् उ वा आहुः पावमान्य एवामुष्य वा एताश् चन्द्रमस ऋचः . एष वै पवमान एष सोमो राजा . तस्मात् कार्या एवेति . सुमन्मा वस्वी रन्ती सूनरी सुरूप वृषन्न् आ गहि इमौ भद्रौ धुर्याव् अभि ताव् इमा उपसर्पतः नीव शीर्षाणि मृढ्वं मध्य आपस्य तिष्ठति शृङ्गेभिर् दशभिर् दिशन् इति ये ह वा एत आदित्यस्य रश्मय एतानि ह वा एतस्य शृङ्गाणि . मध्य उ ह वा एष एतद् अपाम् . तासु वारवतीयम् . यद् अनेन कर्मणावारुत्स्महि तन् नो वारवन्तीयेन वारितम् अन्तत उपतिष्ठाता इति . तद् उ वा आहुर् यद् वावान्या वाङ् नातिवदति तद् एतस्याह्नो ऽग्निष्टोमसाम कार्यम् . यज्ञायज्ञीयं वावान्या वाङ् नातिवदति . वाग् वै यज्ञायज्ञीयम् . कुतो हि वाग् वाचम् अतिवदिष्यति .
2.143.m: Then there are go-nāman (cow-named) [verses]; cattle are the go-nāmans, for the securing of cattle. The first is one-footed (ekapadā); the next two are three-footed (tripadā). They amount to seven feet. The śakvarīs have seven feet. Cattle belong to the śakvarīs — for the securing of cattle from the very beginning. They say the apāvamānī [verses] should not be performed in the pavamāna. But they also say: 'They should be pāvamānīs; these are the verses of yonder moon. He is the pavamāna; he is King Soma; therefore they should be performed.' 'O one of good thoughts, O rich one, O delightful one, O beautiful one, O bull, come!' (sumanmā vasvī rantī sūnarī surūpa vṛṣann ā gahi); 'These two auspicious draft-animals' (imau bhadrau dhuryāv); 'These two attendants approach' (abhi tāv imā upasarpataḥ); 'Bow down your heads' (nīva śīrṣāṇi mṛḍhvam); 'He stands in the middle of the waters' (madhya āpasya tiṣṭhati); 'With ten horns pointing to the directions' (śṛṅgebhir daśabhir diśan) — the rays of the sun are indeed his horns. And he stands in the very middle of the waters. Among them is the vāravantīya [sāman]. 'Whatever we have enclosed by this rite — may the vāravantīya protect it for us, standing at the end.' But they also say: 'Whatever speech no other speech surpasses — that should be the agniṣṭoma-sāman of this day. The yajñāyajñīya is that which no other speech surpasses. For the yajñāyajñīya is speech. How could speech surpass speech?'

2.144.s: athaiṣa vaiśvadevaḥ . prajananakāmo haitena yajeta . prajāpatir vā akāmayata bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeya vaiśvadevīḥ prajās sṛjeyeti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyata vaiśvadevīḥ prajā asṛjata . sa yat kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeya vaiśvadevīḥ prajās sṛjeyeti sa etena yajeta . bahur eva prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate vaiśvadevīḥ prajās sṛjate . tad yad eṣa vaiśvadevo bhavati vaiśvadevīnām eva prajānāṃ sṛṣṭyai . sa sarva eva vaiśvadevīṣu bhavati vaiśvadevīnām eva prajānāṃ prajātyai . sa trivṛd bhavati nyūnaṃ vai trivṛt . nyūnaṃ prajananam tad yat prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . tasya rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati prajananaṃ vai rathantaraṃ tad yat prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . sa ukthyo bhavati prajā vai paśava ukthāni .
2.144.d: अथैष वैश्वदेवः . प्रजननकामो हैतेन यजेत . प्रजापतिर् वा अकामयत बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायेय वैश्वदेवीः प्रजास् सृजेयेति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . ततो वै स बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्राजायत वैश्वदेवीः प्रजा असृजत . स यत् कामयेत बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायेय वैश्वदेवीः प्रजास् सृजेयेति स एतेन यजेत . बहुर् एव प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते वैश्वदेवीः प्रजास् सृजते . तद् यद् एष वैश्वदेवो भवति वैश्वदेवीनाम् एव प्रजानां सृष्ट्यै . स सर्व एव वैश्वदेवीषु भवति वैश्वदेवीनाम् एव प्रजानां प्रजात्यै . स त्रिवृद् भवति न्यूनं वै त्रिवृत् . न्यूनं प्रजननम् तद् यत् प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्य रथन्तरं पृष्ठं भवति प्रजननं वै रथन्तरं तद् यत् प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . स उक्थ्यो भवति प्रजा वै पशव उक्थानि .
2.144.m: Now this is the vaiśvadeva (all-gods rite). One desiring offspring should sacrifice with this. Prajāpati desired: 'May I become abundant in offspring and cattle; may I create creatures belonging to all the gods (vaiśvadevī).' He saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. Then he became abundant in offspring and cattle; he created creatures belonging to all the gods. He who should desire: 'May I become abundant in offspring and cattle; may I create vaiśvadevī creatures' — he should sacrifice with this. He becomes abundant in offspring and cattle; he creates vaiśvadevī creatures. Because this is the vaiśvadeva, it is for the creation of vaiśvadevī creatures. It is entirely in vaiśvadevī [verses], for the procreation of vaiśvadevī creatures. It is trivṛt (threefold). The trivṛt is diminished, as it were; procreation is diminished, as it were — 'May that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' Its pṛṣṭha is the rathantara, for procreation is the rathantara — 'May that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' It is ukthya, for offspring and cattle are the ukthāni.

2.145.s: atho āhus saptadaśa eva syād iti prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ . prajāpatiḥ prajananaṃ sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti . atho āhus triṇava eva syād iti . trayo ha te trivṛtaḥ . nyānaṃ vai trivṛt . nyūnaṃ prajananam . tad yat prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . atho āhus trayastriṃśa eva syād iti . prajāpatir vai trayastriṃśaḥ . prajāpatiḥ prajananam . sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti . tad u vā āhus saptadaśa eva syāt . eṣa ha vāva prajāpatir yat saptadaśaḥ . tasmāt saptadaśa eva syād iti . sa u eva trivṛtaṃ ca stomaṃ gāyatrīṃ ca chando 'bhisaṃpadyate . etad vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ yat trivṛc ca stomo gāyatrī ca chandaḥ . tad yad daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . sa ukthyo bhavati viḍ vā ukthāni vaiśvadevīnām eva prajānāṃ prajātyai . sa haiṣa bhūr eva nāma yajñakratuḥ . etena ha vai yajñeneṣṭvā prajāpatir abhavat . yad abhavat tasmād bhūḥ . bhavati ya evaṃ veda . sa vā eṣa vaiśyasyeva yajño brāhmaṇasyāgniṣṭud rājanyasyendrastomaḥ . yarhi vā etair evaṃ vyākṛtair ījire proktā ha sma manuṣyā vijñāyante . brāhmaṇo vadati rājanyo vadati vaiśyo vadatīti .
2.145.d: अथो आहुस् सप्तदश एव स्याद् इति प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः . प्रजापतिः प्रजननं स यः प्रजननं स मा प्रजनयाद् इति . अथो आहुस् त्रिणव एव स्याद् इति . त्रयो ह ते त्रिवृतः . न्यानं वै त्रिवृत् . न्यूनं प्रजननम् . तद् यत् प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . अथो आहुस् त्रयस्त्रिंश एव स्याद् इति . प्रजापतिर् वै त्रयस्त्रिंशः . प्रजापतिः प्रजननम् . स यः प्रजननं स मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तद् उ वा आहुस् सप्तदश एव स्यात् . एष ह वाव प्रजापतिर् यत् सप्तदशः . तस्मात् सप्तदश एव स्याद् इति . स उ एव त्रिवृतं च स्तोमं गायत्रीं च छन्दो ऽभिसंपद्यते . एतद् वै दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं यत् त्रिवृच् च स्तोमो गायत्री च छन्दः . तद् यद् दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . स उक्थ्यो भवति विड् वा उक्थानि वैश्वदेवीनाम् एव प्रजानां प्रजात्यै . स हैष भूर् एव नाम यज्ञक्रतुः . एतेन ह वै यज्ञेनेष्ट्वा प्रजापतिर् अभवत् . यद् अभवत् तस्माद् भूः . भवति य एवं वेद . स वा एष वैश्यस्येव यज्ञो ब्राह्मणस्याग्निष्टुद् राजन्यस्येन्द्रस्तोमः . यर्हि वा एतैर् एवं व्याकृतैर् ईजिरे प्रोक्ता ह स्म मनुष्या विज्ञायन्ते . ब्राह्मणो वदति राजन्यो वदति वैश्यो वदतीति .
2.145.m: And they say: 'It should be saptadaśa (seventeenfold), for Prajāpati is the saptadaśa; Prajāpati is procreation — may that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' And they say: 'It should be triṇava (twenty-sevenfold), for those are three trivṛts. The trivṛt is diminished; procreation is diminished — may that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' And they say: 'It should be trayastriṃśa (thirty-threefold), for Prajāpati is the trayastriṃśa; Prajāpati is procreation — may that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' But they say: 'It should be saptadaśa, for Prajāpati is indeed the saptadaśa; therefore it should be saptadaśa.' It amounts to the trivṛt stoma and the gāyatrī metre. This is the divine couple (mithuna) of procreation — the trivṛt stoma and the gāyatrī metre — 'May that which is the divine couple of procreation cause me to procreate.' It is ukthya; the ukthāni are the viś (people), for the procreation of vaiśvadevī creatures. This sacrificial rite is called bhū. By sacrificing with this sacrifice, Prajāpati came into being (abhavat). Because he came into being, it is [called] bhū. He who knows thus comes into being. This sacrifice is, as it were, for the vaiśya, as the agniṣṭut is for the brāhmaṇa and the indrastoma for the rājanya. When they sacrificed with these distinct [rites], humans were known and distinguished: 'A brāhmaṇa speaks; a rājanya speaks; a vaiśya speaks.'

2.146.s: athaiṣa upahavyaḥ . prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata . tāsāṃ sṛṣṭānāṃ nāven no eva prajā aviduḥ prajāpatir no 'sṛṣṭeti . sa aikṣata kathaṃ nv imā ahaṃ prajās sṛjeya tāsāṃ sṛṣṭānāṃ na vidyām iti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato 'nenaiva tā upāhvayata . yad upāhvayata tad upahavyasyopahavyatvam . sa saptadaśo 'niruktāsu bhavati . yathā ha vai vanākakṣā evaṃ saptadaśo 'niruktāsu . sa yathā vanākakṣān parītyāvirbhaved evam evaitābhir dṛṣṭavatībhir āvirbabhūva . yad adarṣi gātuvittama ity etāsu dṛṣṭavatīṣv agniṣṭomasāma bhavati . tato vai taṃ tā avidur asya vai vayaṃ smo 'yaṃ vā asmākam āseti . atho hābhyo 'nnam eva bhūto dadṛśe . tā enam annakāśinīḥ prajā abhyupāvavṛtuḥ . tad yasmād rājanyād viśo 'pakrāmeyur brāhmaṇād vā sajātās sa etena yajeta . tasminn ṛtvija upahvayeta .
2.146.d: अथैष उपहव्यः . प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत . तासां सृष्टानां नावेन् नो एव प्रजा अविदुः प्रजापतिर् नो ऽसृष्टेति . स ऐक्षत कथं न्व् इमा अहं प्रजास् सृजेय तासां सृष्टानां न विद्याम् इति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . ततो ऽनेनैव ता उपाह्वयत . यद् उपाह्वयत तद् उपहव्यस्योपहव्यत्वम् . स सप्तदशो ऽनिरुक्तासु भवति . यथा ह वै वनाकक्षा एवं सप्तदशो ऽनिरुक्तासु . स यथा वनाकक्षान् परीत्याविर्भवेद् एवम् एवैताभिर् दृष्टवतीभिर् आविर्बभूव . यद् अदर्षि गातुवित्तम इत्य् एतासु दृष्टवतीष्व् अग्निष्टोमसाम भवति . ततो वै तं ता अविदुर् अस्य वै वयं स्मो ऽयं वा अस्माकम् आसेति . अथो हाभ्यो ऽन्नम् एव भूतो ददृशे . ता एनम् अन्नकाशिनीः प्रजा अभ्युपाववृतुः . तद् यस्माद् राजन्याद् विशो ऽपक्रामेयुर् ब्राह्मणाद् वा सजातास् स एतेन यजेत . तस्मिन्न् ऋत्विज उपह्वयेत .
2.146.m: Now this is the upahavya (summoning rite). Prajāpati created creatures. Of those created, none knew: 'Prajāpati created us.' He considered: 'How might I create these creatures so that, once created, they would know me?' He saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. Then by this very [sacrifice] he summoned them. Because he summoned (upāhvayata), that is the upahavya-ness of the upahavya. It is saptadaśa (seventeenfold), in unspecified (anirukta) [verses]. The saptadaśa in unspecified verses is, as it were, a forest thicket. Just as one would emerge from a forest thicket, so he emerged by these verses containing [the root] dṛś (seeing). 'He has been seen, the best finder of the path' (yad adarṣi gātuvittama) — in these verses containing 'seeing,' the agniṣṭoma-sāman is set. Then they knew him: 'We are indeed his; he is indeed ours.' And he appeared to them as food. Those creatures, seeing food, turned toward him. He from whom the viś (subjects) would depart — whether a rājanya or a brāhmaṇa from whom kinsmen [depart] — he should sacrifice with this. He should summon the priests for it.

2.147.s: tasya rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati . annaṃ vai rathantaram . atho hāsmin bahv eva pakvānnaṃ dadyāt . tā enam annakāśinīḥ prajā abhyupāvartante . prajāpatir yajñam asṛjata . taṃ devebhyaḥ prāyacchat . sa yajñaṃ pradāya riricāno 'manyata . sa aikṣata kathaṃ nv aham imaṃ yajñaṃ punar upahvayeyeti . sa etenaiva yajñenāyajata . tenainaṃ punar upāhvayata . yad upāhvayata tad v evopahavyasyopahavyatvam . tad yaṃ sakṛdiṣṭinaṃ yajño nopanamet sa etena yajeta . apakrānto ha vā etasmād yajño bhavati . yaṃ sakṛdiṣṭinaṃ yajño nopanamaty etena haivainaṃ punar upahvayate .
2.147.d: तस्य रथन्तरं पृष्ठं भवति . अन्नं वै रथन्तरम् . अथो हास्मिन् बह्व् एव पक्वान्नं दद्यात् . ता एनम् अन्नकाशिनीः प्रजा अभ्युपावर्तन्ते . प्रजापतिर् यज्ञम् असृजत . तं देवेभ्यः प्रायच्छत् . स यज्ञं प्रदाय रिरिचानो ऽमन्यत . स ऐक्षत कथं न्व् अहम् इमं यज्ञं पुनर् उपह्वयेयेति . स एतेनैव यज्ञेनायजत . तेनैनं पुनर् उपाह्वयत . यद् उपाह्वयत तद् व् एवोपहव्यस्योपहव्यत्वम् . तद् यं सकृदिष्टिनं यज्ञो नोपनमेत् स एतेन यजेत . अपक्रान्तो ह वा एतस्माद् यज्ञो भवति . यं सकृदिष्टिनं यज्ञो नोपनमत्य् एतेन हैवैनं पुनर् उपह्वयते .
2.147.m: Its pṛṣṭha is the rathantara, for the rathantara is food. And one should give him much cooked food. Those creatures, seeing food, turn back to him. Prajāpati created the sacrifice. He gave it to the gods. Having given away the sacrifice, he felt diminished. He considered: 'How might I summon this sacrifice back?' He sacrificed with this very sacrifice. By it he summoned it back. Because he summoned (upāhvayata), that too is the upahavya-ness of the upahavya. He whom, having sacrificed once, the sacrifice does not approach again — he should sacrifice with this. The sacrifice has departed from him — from one whom, having sacrificed once, the sacrifice does not approach. By this he summons it back.

2.148.s: dvayā u ha vā agre prājāpatyā āsur devāś caivāsurāś ca . tato hābhirādhayattarā iva devā āsur anabhirādhayattarā ivāsurāḥ . sa prajāpatir akāmayata devā eva syuḥ parāsurā bhaveyur iti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tasmin devān upāhvayata . athāsurān dīrghavaṃśenāntaragṛhṇāt . tato vai devā abhavan parāsurāḥ . bhavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda . sa yo bhrātṛvyavān syād yo 'bhicared ya spardheta sa etena yajeta . tad ye 'sya pratikāmīnā ivartvija syus tān upahvayeta . athetarān dīrghavaṃśenāntargṛhṇīyāt .
2.148.d: द्वया उ ह वा अग्रे प्राजापत्या आसुर् देवाश् चैवासुराश् च . ततो हाभिराधयत्तरा इव देवा आसुर् अनभिराधयत्तरा इवासुराः . स प्रजापतिर् अकामयत देवा एव स्युः परासुरा भवेयुर् इति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . तस्मिन् देवान् उपाह्वयत . अथासुरान् दीर्घवंशेनान्तरगृह्णात् . ततो वै देवा अभवन् परासुराः . भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य द्विषन् भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद . स यो भ्रातृव्यवान् स्याद् यो ऽभिचरेद् य स्पर्धेत स एतेन यजेत . तद् ये ऽस्य प्रतिकामीना इवर्त्विज स्युस् तान् उपह्वयेत . अथेतरान् दीर्घवंशेनान्तर्गृह्णीयात् .
2.148.m: In the beginning there were two kinds of Prājāpatya beings — gods and asuras. Of them, the gods were, as it were, more successful; the asuras less successful. Prajāpati desired: 'May the gods prevail; may the asuras perish.' He saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. In it he summoned the gods. And the asuras he shut out with the long pole (dīrghavaṃśa). Then the gods prevailed and the asuras perished. He prevails by his own self; his hateful rival perishes — he who knows thus. He who has a rival, who is attacked by sorcery, who has a competitor — he should sacrifice with this. Those of his priests who are, as it were, favorable to him — them he should summon. The others he should shut out with the long pole.

2.149.s: athaiṣa tīvrasomaḥ . prajākāmo haitena yajeta . tanur iva ha vā eṣa yo 'prajaḥ . prajayo ha vai puruṣas tīvro bahulaḥ . prajayā tīvro bahulo 'sānīti . atho āhuḥ paśukāma evainena yajeteti . tanur iva ha vā eṣa yo 'paśuḥ . paśubhir ha vai puruṣas tīvro bahulaḥ . paśubhis tīvro bahulo 'sānīti . sa saptadaśo bhavati . eṣa ha vai tīvro bahulo yat saptadaśaḥ . prajayā paśubhis tīvro bahulo 'sānīti . tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavataḥ . ete ha vai tīvre bahule yad ubhe bṛhadrathantare . prajayā paśubhis tīvro bahulo 'sānīti . tasya vaḍavā garbhiṇī dakṣiṇā bhavati . eṣā ha vai tīvrā bahulā yad vaḍavā . tīvrā tena bahulā yad garbhiṇī . tīvrā tena bahulā yad ubhayatodatī . tīvrā tena bahulā yad ekā satī bahvīr gā arhati . prajayā paśubhis tīvro bahulo 'sānīti . atho āhur dhenuśatam evāsya nānāvatsaṃ dakṣiṇā syād iti . etad dha vai tīvraṃ bahulaṃ yad dhenuśatam . tīvraṃ tena bahulaṃ yac chatam . tīvraṃ tena bahulam yad asya payaḥ . tīvraṃ tena bahulaṃ yad asya vatsāḥ .
2.149.d: अथैष तीव्रसोमः . प्रजाकामो हैतेन यजेत . तनुर् इव ह वा एष यो ऽप्रजः . प्रजयो ह वै पुरुषस् तीव्रो बहुलः . प्रजया तीव्रो बहुलो ऽसानीति . अथो आहुः पशुकाम एवैनेन यजेतेति . तनुर् इव ह वा एष यो ऽपशुः . पशुभिर् ह वै पुरुषस् तीव्रो बहुलः . पशुभिस् तीव्रो बहुलो ऽसानीति . स सप्तदशो भवति . एष ह वै तीव्रो बहुलो यत् सप्तदशः . प्रजया पशुभिस् तीव्रो बहुलो ऽसानीति . तस्योभे बृहद्रथन्तरे सामनी भवतः . एते ह वै तीव्रे बहुले यद् उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे . प्रजया पशुभिस् तीव्रो बहुलो ऽसानीति . तस्य वडवा गर्भिणी दक्षिणा भवति . एषा ह वै तीव्रा बहुला यद् वडवा . तीव्रा तेन बहुला यद् गर्भिणी . तीव्रा तेन बहुला यद् उभयतोदती . तीव्रा तेन बहुला यद् एका सती बह्वीर् गा अर्हति . प्रजया पशुभिस् तीव्रो बहुलो ऽसानीति . अथो आहुर् धेनुशतम् एवास्य नानावत्सं दक्षिणा स्याद् इति . एतद् ध वै तीव्रं बहुलं यद् धेनुशतम् . तीव्रं तेन बहुलं यच् छतम् . तीव्रं तेन बहुलम् यद् अस्य पयः . तीव्रं तेन बहुलं यद् अस्य वत्साः .
2.149.m: Now this is the tīvrasoma (intense soma). One desiring offspring should sacrifice with this. He who is without offspring is, as it were, thin. Through offspring a man becomes intense (tīvra) and abundant (bahula) — 'May I become intense and abundant through offspring.' And they say: 'One desiring cattle should sacrifice with this. He who is without cattle is, as it were, thin. Through cattle a man becomes intense and abundant — may I become intense and abundant through cattle.' It is saptadaśa (seventeenfold), for the saptadaśa is indeed intense and abundant — 'May I become intense and abundant through offspring and cattle.' It has both bṛhat and rathantara as its sāmans, for those two are intense and abundant — 'May I become intense and abundant through offspring and cattle.' Its dakṣiṇā is a pregnant mare. A mare is intense and abundant; she is intense and abundant because she is pregnant; she is intense and abundant because she has teeth on both sides; she is intense and abundant because, being one, she is worth many cows — 'May I become intense and abundant through offspring and cattle.' And they say: 'His dakṣiṇā should be a hundred cows with different calves.' A hundred cows are indeed intense and abundant: intense and abundant because they are a hundred; intense and abundant because of their milk; intense and abundant because of their calves.

2.150.s: indro vṛtraṃ vajreṇādhyasya nāstṛṣīti manyamānaḥ parāṃ parāvatam agacchat . taṃ devā anvaicchan . taṃ nānvavindan . te 'bruvann abhiṣuṇavāmaiva . tata āgamiṣyatīti . te 'bhyaṣuṇvan . teṣāṃ ha sarvam eva prātassavanaṃ nājagāma . te ha sma camasān urasy upanigrāham abhyunnayante ned apendrasya somasya bhakṣayāmeti . sa u ha mādhyaṃdine savana ājagāma . te hotkrodaṃ cakrire yathā śreṣṭhiny āgata utkrodaṃ kurvate tathā . tad u vā āhur acchāvākasyed vāva stotre prātassavana ājagāma . antarito vai tathā yajñād abhaviṣyad yad acchāvākasya stotre prātassavane nāgamiṣyad iti . tasmād etasya yajñasyācchāvākasya stotre bhakṣayanti . tasmād v acchāvākāyobhāv adhvaryū pratyāgṛhṇītaḥ sarve camasādhvaryavaḥ . utkrodam eva tat kurvate . tad yasmāc chrīr apakrāmet sa etena yajeta . śrīr vai teṣāṃ sāpākrāmad yad eṣāṃ śreṣṭhy apākrāmat . tām etenaivānvavindan .
2.150.d: इन्द्रो वृत्रं वज्रेणाध्यस्य नास्तृषीति मन्यमानः परां परावतम् अगच्छत् . तं देवा अन्वैच्छन् . तं नान्वविन्दन् . ते ऽब्रुवन्न् अभिषुणवामैव . तत आगमिष्यतीति . ते ऽभ्यषुण्वन् . तेषां ह सर्वम् एव प्रातस्सवनं नाजगाम . ते ह स्म चमसान् उरस्य् उपनिग्राहम् अभ्युन्नयन्ते नेद् अपेन्द्रस्य सोमस्य भक्षयामेति . स उ ह माध्यंदिने सवन आजगाम . ते होत्क्रोदं चक्रिरे यथा श्रेष्ठिन्य् आगत उत्क्रोदं कुर्वते तथा . तद् उ वा आहुर् अच्छावाकस्येद् वाव स्तोत्रे प्रातस्सवन आजगाम . अन्तरितो वै तथा यज्ञाद् अभविष्यद् यद् अच्छावाकस्य स्तोत्रे प्रातस्सवने नागमिष्यद् इति . तस्माद् एतस्य यज्ञस्याच्छावाकस्य स्तोत्रे भक्षयन्ति . तस्माद् व् अच्छावाकायोभाव् अध्वर्यू प्रत्यागृह्णीतः सर्वे चमसाध्वर्यवः . उत्क्रोदम् एव तत् कुर्वते . तद् यस्माच् छ्रीर् अपक्रामेत् स एतेन यजेत . श्रीर् वै तेषां सापाक्रामद् यद् एषां श्रेष्ठ्य् अपाक्रामत् . ताम् एतेनैवान्वविन्दन् .
2.150.m: Indra, having struck Vṛtra with his vajra, thinking 'I have not vanquished him,' went to the farthest distance. The gods searched for him. They did not find him. They said: 'Let us just press the soma; he will come from there.' They pressed. He did not come for the entire morning pressing. They raised the cups to their chests, holding them close, [saying:] 'Let us not drink of the soma without Indra.' But he came at the midday pressing. They made a joyful clamor, as people make a joyful clamor when the chief has arrived. But they say: 'He came at the very stotra of the acchāvāka priest, at the morning pressing. He would have been excluded from the sacrifice had he not come at the stotra of the acchāvāka at the morning pressing.' Therefore at this sacrifice they partake at the stotra of the acchāvāka. Therefore both adhvaryus receive back [the cups] for the acchāvāka, and all the cup-bearing adhvaryus. They make the joyful clamor. He from whom glory (śrī) departs should sacrifice with this. For their glory departed when their chief departed. By this very [sacrifice] they found it again.

2.151.s: triśīrṣā ha vai tvāṣṭra āsa . tasya ha trīṇi mukhāny āsus somapānam ekaṃ surāpānam ekam annādanam ekam . prastauti ha smaikenaikena gāyati pratiharaty ekenāśrāvayaty ekena pratyāśrāvayaty ekena śaṃsaty ekena . sa ha smaikāky evānuparisarpaṃ sarvaṃ yajñaṃ saṃsthāpayati . sa heyadvīryāvān āsa . sa u hāsurīputra āsa . sa ha sma pratyakṣaṃ devebhyo vadati parokṣam asurebhyaḥ . yasmā u ha vā bhūyaḥ kāmayate tasmai parokṣaṃ vadati . tasmād u hendro bibhayāṃ cakāra yac cāsurīputra āsa yad u ceyadvīryāvān āsa . sa hekṣāṃ cakre 'suryo vā ayam āsurīputraḥ . sa pratyakṣam asmabhyaṃ vadati parokṣam asurebhyaḥ .
2.151.d: त्रिशीर्षा ह वै त्वाष्ट्र आस . तस्य ह त्रीणि मुखान्य् आसुस् सोमपानम् एकं सुरापानम् एकम् अन्नादनम् एकम् . प्रस्तौति ह स्मैकेनैकेन गायति प्रतिहरत्य् एकेनाश्रावयत्य् एकेन प्रत्याश्रावयत्य् एकेन शंसत्य् एकेन . स ह स्मैकाक्य् एवानुपरिसर्पं सर्वं यज्ञं संस्थापयति . स हेयद्वीर्यावान् आस . स उ हासुरीपुत्र आस . स ह स्म प्रत्यक्षं देवेभ्यो वदति परोक्षम् असुरेभ्यः . यस्मा उ ह वा भूयः कामयते तस्मै परोक्षं वदति . तस्माद् उ हेन्द्रो बिभयां चकार यच् चासुरीपुत्र आस यद् उ चेयद्वीर्यावान् आस . स हेक्षां चक्रे ऽसुर्यो वा अयम् आसुरीपुत्रः . स प्रत्यक्षम् अस्मभ्यं वदति परोक्षम् असुरेभ्यः .
2.151.m: Triśīrṣā Tvāṣṭra (the three-headed son of Tvaṣṭṛ) indeed had three mouths: one for soma-drinking, one for surā-drinking, and one for food-eating. With one he would chant the prastāva, with one he would sing, with one he would make the pratihāra, with one he would call out the āśrāvaya, with one he would respond with the pratyāśrāvaya, with one he would recite the śastra. He alone, going around, would bring the entire sacrifice to completion. He was of such great power. And he was the son of an Asura woman. He would speak openly to the gods and secretly to the Asuras. To whomever he was more favorably disposed, to him he would speak secretly. Therefore Indra feared him, both because he was the son of an Asura woman and because he was of such great power. He reflected: 'This one is of Asura nature, being the son of an Asura woman. He speaks openly to us and secretly to the Asuras.'

2.152.s: tasya ha vajreṇa śīrṣāṇi praciccheda . tāny eva vayāṃsy abhavan . tad yat somapānam āsīt sa kapiñjalo 'bhavat . tasmāt sa babhrur iva . babhrur iva hi somaḥ . atha yat surāpānam āsīt sa kalaviṅko 'bhavat . tasmāt sa matta ivāvakrandati . atha yad annādanam āsīt sa tittirir abhavat . tasmāt sa bahurūpa iva . bahurūpam iva hy annam . tasmād u tasya vṛścikaś śaṅkuliṣṭha ity etad annam . sa tvaṣṭā hataputro 'pendraṃ somam ājahre .
2.152.d: तस्य ह वज्रेण शीर्षाणि प्रचिच्छेद . तान्य् एव वयांस्य् अभवन् . तद् यत् सोमपानम् आसीत् स कपिञ्जलो ऽभवत् . तस्मात् स बभ्रुर् इव . बभ्रुर् इव हि सोमः . अथ यत् सुरापानम् आसीत् स कलविङ्को ऽभवत् . तस्मात् स मत्त इवावक्रन्दति . अथ यद् अन्नादनम् आसीत् स तित्तिरिर् अभवत् . तस्मात् स बहुरूप इव . बहुरूपम् इव ह्य् अन्नम् . तस्माद् उ तस्य वृश्चिकश् शङ्कुलिष्ठ इत्य् एतद् अन्नम् . स त्वष्टा हतपुत्रो ऽपेन्द्रं सोमम् आजह्रे .
2.152.m: He cut off his heads with the vajra. They became birds. That which was the soma-drinking head became the kapiñjala (francolin partridge). Therefore it is brownish, for soma is brownish. Then that which was the surā-drinking head became the kalaviṅka (sparrow). Therefore it cries out as if intoxicated. Then that which was the food-eating head became the tittiri (partridge). Therefore it is of many colors, for food is of many colors. Therefore its food is vṛścika (scorpion) and śaṅkuliṣṭha. Tvaṣṭṛ, whose son had been slain, drew soma away from Indra.

2.153.s: taṃ ha vajrahasto 'bhidudrāva . sa tvaṣṭā pratyaṅ patitvā patnīḥ prapede . taṃ ha tatra nānuprapede . tasmāt tvaṣṭāraṃ patnīṣu saṃyajanti . tasmād u patnīḥ prapannaṃ na hanyāt . udeyāyendraḥ . sa havirdhānayor eva droṇakalaśe somaṃ rājānaṃ saṃpavitum upeyāya . taṃ ha droṇakalaśenaiva pratidhāya pītvā pravavrāja . anūdeyāya tvaṣṭā . sa ha papracchāsti kiṃcit pariśiṣṭā3m iti . asty ayaṃ saṃsrāva iti hocuḥ . taṃ hāgnau pravartayāṃ cakār endraśatrur vardhasva svāhe ti . taṃ yat prāvartayat sa eva vṛtro 'bhavat . sa vartamāna evāgnīṣomāv abhisaṃbabhūva . tasmād āhur agnīṣomāv asuryāv iti . sa ha smeṣumātram ūrdhvam udardati . tato ha smānāvacchāṃ kṣitis (?). sa trayīṃ vidyāṃ sarvāṃ śriyaṃ sarvam annādyam api yad idaṃ trirātre sahasraṃ procyate tad abhisaṃbabhūva . tasya hedaṃ sarvaṃ balikṛd āsa . kīlālaṃ ha smāsmai nadyo vahanti . atha hābhiyugvāno nāmāṣṭau devānāṃ sahacarā āsur aṣṭau pitr̥̄ṇām aṣṭau manuṣyāṇām aṣṭāv asurāṇām . teṣāṃ ha smendro māyayāṣṭamo bhavati vṛtraṃ jighāṃsan . tasmād u hainam indra eva jaghāna yad indraśatrur vardhasva svāhe ti pravartayāṃ cakāra . /atha yad dha prāvartayiṣyad indrasya śatrur vardhasva svāhe ti - Hier liegt ein weiterer Fall der Unterbrechung eines zusammengehörigen Satzes durch die Kapitelzählung im # JB
2.153.d: तं ह वज्रहस्तो ऽभिदुद्राव . स त्वष्टा प्रत्यङ् पतित्वा पत्नीः प्रपेदे . तं ह तत्र नानुप्रपेदे . तस्मात् त्वष्टारं पत्नीषु संयजन्ति . तस्माद् उ पत्नीः प्रपन्नं न हन्यात् . उदेयायेन्द्रः . स हविर्धानयोर् एव द्रोणकलशे सोमं राजानं संपवितुम् उपेयाय . तं ह द्रोणकलशेनैव प्रतिधाय पीत्वा प्रवव्राज . अनूदेयाय त्वष्टा . स ह पप्रच्छास्ति किंचित् परिशिष्टा३म् इति . अस्त्य् अयं संस्राव इति होचुः . तं हाग्नौ प्रवर्तयां चकार् एन्द्रशत्रुर् वर्धस्व स्वाहे ति . तं यत् प्रावर्तयत् स एव वृत्रो ऽभवत् . स वर्तमान एवाग्नीषोमाव् अभिसंबभूव . तस्माद् आहुर् अग्नीषोमाव् असुर्याव् इति . स ह स्मेषुमात्रम् ऊर्ध्वम् उदर्दति . ततो ह स्मानावच्छां क्षितिस् (?). स त्रयीं विद्यां सर्वां श्रियं सर्वम् अन्नाद्यम् अपि यद् इदं त्रिरात्रे सहस्रं प्रोच्यते तद् अभिसंबभूव . तस्य हेदं सर्वं बलिकृद् आस . कीलालं ह स्मास्मै नद्यो वहन्ति . अथ हाभियुग्वानो नामाष्टौ देवानां सहचरा आसुर् अष्टौ पित्र्̥̄णाम् अष्टौ मनुष्याणाम् अष्टाव् असुराणाम् . तेषां ह स्मेन्द्रो माययाष्टमो भवति वृत्रं जिघांसन् . तस्माद् उ हैनम् इन्द्र एव जघान यद् इन्द्रशत्रुर् वर्धस्व स्वाहे ति प्रवर्तयां चकार . /अथ यद् ध प्रावर्तयिष्यद् इन्द्रस्य शत्रुर् वर्धस्व स्वाहे ति - Hइएर् लिएग्त् एइन् wएइतेरेर् Fअल्ल् देर् Uन्तेर्ब्रेछुन्ग् एइनेस् zउसम्मेन्गेह्öरिगेन् Sअत्zएस् दुर्छ् दिए Kअपितेल्zäह्लुन्ग् इम् # JB
2.153.m: Indra, vajra in hand, rushed upon him. Tvaṣṭṛ, fleeing backward, took refuge among the wives. Indra did not follow him there. Therefore they offer to Tvaṣṭṛ among the wives (in the patnīsaṃyāja). Therefore one should not slay one who has taken refuge among women. Indra went up. He approached the droṇakalaśa in the havirdhāna shed to drink soma, the king. Having held it back with the droṇakalaśa itself, he drank and departed. Tvaṣṭṛ came up after him. He asked: 'Is anything left over?' 'There is this saṃsrāva (residue),' they said. He poured that into the fire with the formula 'indraśatru (O enemy of Indra), grow! svāhā!' That which he poured forth became Vṛtra. Even as it was growing, it encompassed Agni and Soma. Therefore they say 'Agni and Soma are of Asura nature.' It would shoot up the height of an arrow-shot. Thence there was no respite for creatures. He encompassed the threefold knowledge, all prosperity, all food—even the thousand that is recited in the trirātra, he encompassed that. Everything here was his tribute-payer. The rivers carried kīlāla (sweet drink) for him. Now there were companions called Abhiyugvānas—eight of the gods, eight of the Fathers, eight of men, eight of the Asuras. Among them Indra became the eighth by māyā, seeking to slay Vṛtra. Therefore it was Indra alone who slew him, because he had poured it with the formula 'indraśatru (O enemy of Indra), grow! svāhā!' But had he poured it with 'indrasya śatru (O enemy of Indra [with genitive]), grow! svāhā!'—[here the text notes a case of sentence-interruption by chapter division in the JB]

2.154.s: - śaśvad dhainaṃ nāhaniṣyat . tam ayam indraṃ somo rājā pīto 'nupahūto 'hinot . tasya ha sarvebhya eva chidrebhyaḥ preyāya mukhād eva na . tasmād u ha bhiṣajya āsa . tasya yad avāg iyāya saiva surāvāriṭakā babhūva . yac chiśnāt sā parisruk . trir niraṣṭhīvat . tad yat prathamaṃ niraṣṭhīvat tad eva karkandhv abhavad yad dvitīyaṃ tad badaraṃ yat tṛtīyaṃ tat kvalam . tasmād eteṣām annaṃ caiva rasāḥ . khāṭkṛtya caturthaṃ niraṣṭhīvat . tad evāmram abhavat . tam evaṃ santaṃ devā abhito niṣeduḥ . ayaṃ na eko vīro 'bhūt . sa itthaṃ nyagāt . kva bhavāma iti . sa hovāca na vai vidma yatra bhūmeti . kim iti . cukṣūṣāmi vā iti . atha ha sma tataḥ purā kṣutvaiva mriyante . taṃ hocuḥ kṣuhi jīveti tvā vakṣyāma iti . sa ha cukṣāva . taṃ ha jīvety ūcuḥ . sa ha jijīva . tasmād idam apy etarhi cukṣvāṃsam āhur jīveti .
2.154.d: - शश्वद् धैनं नाहनिष्यत् . तम् अयम् इन्द्रं सोमो राजा पीतो ऽनुपहूतो ऽहिनोत् . तस्य ह सर्वेभ्य एव छिद्रेभ्यः प्रेयाय मुखाद् एव न . तस्माद् उ ह भिषज्य आस . तस्य यद् अवाग् इयाय सैव सुरावारिटका बभूव . यच् छिश्नात् सा परिस्रुक् . त्रिर् निरष्ठीवत् . तद् यत् प्रथमं निरष्ठीवत् तद् एव कर्कन्ध्व् अभवद् यद् द्वितीयं तद् बदरं यत् तृतीयं तत् क्वलम् . तस्माद् एतेषाम् अन्नं चैव रसाः . खाट्कृत्य चतुर्थं निरष्ठीवत् . तद् एवाम्रम् अभवत् . तम् एवं सन्तं देवा अभितो निषेदुः . अयं न एको वीरो ऽभूत् . स इत्थं न्यगात् . क्व भवाम इति . स होवाच न वै विद्म यत्र भूमेति . किम् इति . चुक्षूषामि वा इति . अथ ह स्म ततः पुरा क्षुत्वैव म्रियन्ते . तं होचुः क्षुहि जीवेति त्वा वक्ष्याम इति . स ह चुक्षाव . तं ह जीवेत्य् ऊचुः . स ह जिजीव . तस्माद् इदम् अप्य् एतर्हि चुक्ष्वांसम् आहुर् जीवेति .
2.154.m: —he would never have been able to slay him. Soma, the king, having been drunk but not properly invited, injured this Indra. It flowed out from all his openings, but not from his mouth. Therefore there was a need for healing. That which flowed downward became the surāvāriṭakā plant. That which came from the śiśna (penis) became the parisruk (overflow libation). He spat out three times. That which he spat out the first time became the karkandhū (jujube); the second, the badara (Indian jujube); the third, the kvala (a type of jujube). Therefore these have both food and juice. Making a 'khāṭ' sound, he spat a fourth time. That became the āmra (mango). The gods sat around him in this condition. 'This one hero of ours has fallen thus. Where shall we be?' He said: 'We truly do not know where we shall be.' 'Why?' 'I am about to sneeze.' Now before that time, creatures would die merely from sneezing. They said to him: 'Sneeze! We shall say to you "live!"' He sneezed. They said 'Live!' to him. He lived. Therefore even now, when someone sneezes, they say 'live!' to him.

2.155.s: - tāv eva siṃhāv abhavatām . yad akṣibhyāṃ tau śārdūlau yat karṇābhyāṃ tau vṛkau vailūṣau yad upapakṣābhyāṃ tāv apāṣṭihau . tasmād ete vayasāṃ vīryāvattarāḥ . indro hy eteṣām ājānam . atha yad avāg iyāya tad idaṃ kṣudraṃ śvāpadaṃ babhūva . sa ha viṣiktaś śiśye . api ha tṛṇair abhivilūḍha āsa . taṃ hocuḥ kvevāsi kveva tvā bhiṣajyāma iti . tasmād idam apy etarhi upatāpinaṃ pṛcchanti kveva te rujati kveva te bhiṣajyāma iti . sa ha tṛṇāny abhiparidiśann uvācedam ivaiva mābhito 'smīdam ivaiva mābhito bhiṣajyateti . tad agnim abruvann idaṃ daheti . tad agnir adahat . tat parjanyam abruvann idam abhi varṣeti . tat parjanyo 'bhyavarṣat . tat kalyāṇy oṣadhayo 'jāyanta . tā dhenūbhir ādhayan . tat payo 'duhan . ta etaṃ yajñam apaśyan . tam āharan . tenainam ayājayan . tasya pratidhuk prātassavane 'vānayan . pratīva vā anenādhāyīti tasmāt pratidhuk . śritaṃ mādhyaṃdine savane 'śreṣṭeva vā aneneti tasmāc chritam . dadhi tṛtīyasavane 'dādhīva vā aneneti tasmād dadhi . sa yathā ca ha pura āsātitarāṃ ha tata āsa . sa yas somavāmī vā somātipavito vā syāt sa etena yajeta . yathā ca ha purā bhavaty atitarāṃ ha tato bhavati . tasmād u ha somavāminaṃ vā somātipavitaṃ vā na paricakṣīta .
2.155.d: - ताव् एव सिंहाव् अभवताम् . यद् अक्षिभ्यां तौ शार्दूलौ यत् कर्णाभ्यां तौ वृकौ वैलूषौ यद् उपपक्षाभ्यां ताव् अपाष्टिहौ . तस्माद् एते वयसां वीर्यावत्तराः . इन्द्रो ह्य् एतेषाम् आजानम् . अथ यद् अवाग् इयाय तद् इदं क्षुद्रं श्वापदं बभूव . स ह विषिक्तश् शिश्ये . अपि ह तृणैर् अभिविलूढ आस . तं होचुः क्वेवासि क्वेव त्वा भिषज्याम इति . तस्माद् इदम् अप्य् एतर्हि उपतापिनं पृच्छन्ति क्वेव ते रुजति क्वेव ते भिषज्याम इति . स ह तृणान्य् अभिपरिदिशन्न् उवाचेदम् इवैव माभितो ऽस्मीदम् इवैव माभितो भिषज्यतेति . तद् अग्निम् अब्रुवन्न् इदं दहेति . तद् अग्निर् अदहत् . तत् पर्जन्यम् अब्रुवन्न् इदम् अभि वर्षेति . तत् पर्जन्यो ऽभ्यवर्षत् . तत् कल्याण्य् ओषधयो ऽजायन्त . ता धेनूभिर् आधयन् . तत् पयो ऽदुहन् . त एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यन् . तम् आहरन् . तेनैनम् अयाजयन् . तस्य प्रतिधुक् प्रातस्सवने ऽवानयन् . प्रतीव वा अनेनाधायीति तस्मात् प्रतिधुक् . श्रितं माध्यंदिने सवने ऽश्रेष्टेव वा अनेनेति तस्माच् छ्रितम् . दधि तृतीयसवने ऽदाधीव वा अनेनेति तस्माद् दधि . स यथा च ह पुर आसातितरां ह तत आस . स यस् सोमवामी वा सोमातिपवितो वा स्यात् स एतेन यजेत . यथा च ह पुरा भवत्य् अतितरां ह ततो भवति . तस्माद् उ ह सोमवामिनं वा सोमातिपवितं वा न परिचक्षीत .
2.155.m: Those two (eyes) became lions. That which came from the eyes became the two śārdūlas (tigers); that from the ears, the two vṛkas (wolves) called vailūṣa; that from the sides, the two apāṣṭihas (a kind of bird). Therefore these are the most powerful among birds, for Indra was their origin. Then that which flowed downward became these small wild animals. He lay there drained. He was even covered over with grass. They said: 'Where are you? Where shall we heal you?' Therefore even now they ask a sick person: 'Where does it hurt? Where shall we treat you?' He said, pointing around at the grass: 'It is as if I am surrounded by this; heal me all around this.' They said to Agni: 'Burn this.' Agni burned it. They said to Parjanya: 'Rain upon this.' Parjanya rained upon it. Auspicious herbs grew. They nursed them with cows. They milked milk from them. They saw this sacrifice. They brought it. With it they made him sacrifice. The pratidhuk (first milk) they offered at the morning pressing—'It is as if he were replenished by this,' therefore the pratidhuk. The cooked milk at the midday pressing—'It is as if he were heated by this,' therefore cooked milk. Curds at the third pressing—'It is as if he were thickened by this,' therefore curds. He became even better than he had been before. He who has vomited soma or who has over-filtered soma should sacrifice with this. He becomes even better than he was before. Therefore one should not despise one who has vomited soma or over-filtered soma.

2.156.s: athaiṣa ṛtapeyaḥ . devebhyo vā ūrg annādyam udakrāmat . somāhutir ha vā ebhyas soccakrāma . so eva virāṭ . te devā abruvann etemāṃ virājam anvicchāmeti . te tatpo 'tapyanta . ta etāṃ virājaṃ yajñam apaśyan . tam āharanta . tam abhy adīkṣanta . ta ekam ahar nāśnan . tasyai niyānam anvapaśyan . te 'bruvan bhūyo nv eva tapas tapyāmahā iti . te dvitīyam ahar nāśnan . tasyai ghoṣam upāśṛṇvan . te 'bruvan bhūyo nv eva tapas tapyāmahā iti . te tṛtīyam ahar nāśnan . tāṃ parāpaśyan yathā mahāntaṃ girim udīkṣitaṃ yathā vā mahad abhram evam . tām abhikrāmam apakrāmam abhyatsaran . ya u ha vai mṛgaṃ parāṅ evābhitsarati nainaṃ sa gṛhṇāti . atha ya enam abhikrāmam apakrāmam abhitsarati sa evainaṃ gṛhṇāti . tāṃ daśamenaivāhnāvarundhata . daśākṣarā virāṭ . annaṃ virāṭ .
2.156.d: अथैष ऋतपेयः . देवेभ्यो वा ऊर्ग् अन्नाद्यम् उदक्रामत् . सोमाहुतिर् ह वा एभ्यस् सोच्चक्राम . सो एव विराट् . ते देवा अब्रुवन्न् एतेमां विराजम् अन्विच्छामेति . ते तत्पो ऽतप्यन्त . त एतां विराजं यज्ञम् अपश्यन् . तम् आहरन्त . तम् अभ्य् अदीक्षन्त . त एकम् अहर् नाश्नन् . तस्यै नियानम् अन्वपश्यन् . ते ऽब्रुवन् भूयो न्व् एव तपस् तप्यामहा इति . ते द्वितीयम् अहर् नाश्नन् . तस्यै घोषम् उपाशृण्वन् . ते ऽब्रुवन् भूयो न्व् एव तपस् तप्यामहा इति . ते तृतीयम् अहर् नाश्नन् . तां परापश्यन् यथा महान्तं गिरिम् उदीक्षितं यथा वा महद् अभ्रम् एवम् . ताम् अभिक्रामम् अपक्रामम् अभ्यत्सरन् . य उ ह वै मृगं पराङ् एवाभित्सरति नैनं स गृह्णाति . अथ य एनम् अभिक्रामम् अपक्रामम् अभित्सरति स एवैनं गृह्णाति . तां दशमेनैवाह्नावरुन्धत . दशाक्षरा विराट् . अन्नं विराट् .
2.156.m: Now this is the ṛtapeya. From the gods, vigor and food-eating departed. The soma libation, the virāj, departed from them. The gods said: 'Come, let us seek this virāj.' They performed tapas. They saw this sacrifice, the virāj. They brought it. They consecrated themselves for it. They did not eat for one day. They perceived her trail. They said: 'Let us perform still more tapas.' They did not eat for a second day. They heard her sound. They said: 'Let us perform still more tapas.' They did not eat for a third day. They saw her in the distance—as one might look up at a great mountain, or like a great cloud. They pursued her, approaching and retreating. He who chases a wild animal only going forward does not catch it. But he who pursues it approaching and retreating catches it. They obtained her on the tenth day. The virāj has ten syllables. Food is the virāj.

2.157.s: tasyāpaś ca ghṛtaṃ ca vratam . aśarīrā vā āpo 'śarīraṃ ghṛtam aśarīrā svadhā . aśarīreṇāśarīrāṃ svadhām avaruṇadhāmahā iti . etāvaccho vratayati . etāvatī vai puruṣasya mātrā net puruṣam ativratayānīti . atho haitat parvaśa evātmano 'ṅgāni pratisaṃdadhāti . sarpiṣmān antareṇa bhavati samaṣṭyai . saptadaśastomo bhavati . prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ . prajāpatir naṣṭasyānuvettā . sa yo naṣṭasyānuvettā tenemāṃ svadhām anuvindāmeti . tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmnī bhavato yady asmin loke rathantareṇānuvindāma yady antarikṣe vāmadevyena yady amuṣmin loke bṛhateti . tasyaudumbaras somacamaso dakṣiṇā bhavaty ūrg vā annam udumbara ūrja evānnādyasyāvaruddhyai .
2.157.d: तस्यापश् च घृतं च व्रतम् . अशरीरा वा आपो ऽशरीरं घृतम् अशरीरा स्वधा . अशरीरेणाशरीरां स्वधाम् अवरुणधामहा इति . एतावच्छो व्रतयति . एतावती वै पुरुषस्य मात्रा नेत् पुरुषम् अतिव्रतयानीति . अथो हैतत् पर्वश एवात्मनो ऽङ्गानि प्रतिसंदधाति . सर्पिष्मान् अन्तरेण भवति समष्ट्यै . सप्तदशस्तोमो भवति . प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः . प्रजापतिर् नष्टस्यानुवेत्ता . स यो नष्टस्यानुवेत्ता तेनेमां स्वधाम् अनुविन्दामेति . तस्योभे बृहद्रथन्तरे साम्नी भवतो यद्य् अस्मिन् लोके रथन्तरेणानुविन्दाम यद्य् अन्तरिक्षे वामदेव्येन यद्य् अमुष्मिन् लोके बृहतेति . तस्यौदुम्बरस् सोमचमसो दक्षिणा भवत्य् ऊर्ग् वा अन्नम् उदुम्बर ऊर्ज एवान्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्यै .
2.157.m: Water and ghee are her observance. Water is bodiless; ghee is bodiless; svadhā is bodiless. 'With the bodiless let us secure the bodiless svadhā.' One observes the vow for this much—for this is the measure of a person, 'lest I over-observe the vow beyond the person.' And thereby one reassembles one's limbs, joint by joint. One has ghee in between, for the sake of completeness. The stoma is saptadaśa (seventeen-fold). Prajāpati is saptadaśa. Prajāpati is the finder of what is lost. 'May he who is the finder of what is lost, by him let us find this svadhā.' Both Bṛhat and Rathantara are its sāmans—'If in this world we find it with the Rathantara, or in the atmosphere with the Vāmadevya, or in yonder world with the Bṛhat.' Its dakṣiṇā is a soma cup made of udumbara wood—for vigor and food are the udumbara; for the securing of vigor and food-eating.

2.158.s: taṃ brahmaṇe dadāti . brahmaṇo hy evaikadakṣiṇā . tad āhur huto deyā3 ahutā3 iti . ahuta ity āhuḥ . yātayāmeva vai tathā syād yad dhutaṃ dadyād iti . tad u vā āhur huta eva deyaḥ . devānāṃ vā eṣa bhāgaḥ . ko devānāṃ bhāgaṃ dātum arhati . tasmād dhuta eva deya iti . yādṛg aha vā asmin loke 'nnaṃ dadāti tādṛg asyāmuṣmin loke 'nnaṃ bhavati . etad u ha vā amuṣmin loke paramam annādyaṃ yat somapīthaḥ . eṣā haivāsya somāhutir amuṣmin loke 'nnaṃ bhavati . ṛtaṃ satyaṃ vadanto bhakṣayanti . ṛtena hi te tāṃ satyenānvavindan . ṛtam amṛtam ity āha . ṛtena hi te tad amṛtam anvavindan . o yi jvarā oyi jūhe ti sāmanidhane bhavato vācas satye . vāco hi te tāṃ satyenānvavindan . tena haitenāthodivo gārgya īje keśī dārbhya ṛjiśvā vātavāta iti . sa harjiśvā vātavāto 'vatatāma . tam u ha vṛṣaśuṣmeṇa kumāreṇārjiśvanenāktākṣeṇopaniṣedur yady ayam u riṣyaty anenedaṃ samāpayiṣyāma iti . sa ha tatāma . sa ha tāntaḥ paraṃ lokaṃ jagāma .
2.158.d: तं ब्रह्मणे ददाति . ब्रह्मणो ह्य् एवैकदक्षिणा . तद् आहुर् हुतो देया३ अहुता३ इति . अहुत इत्य् आहुः . यातयामेव वै तथा स्याद् यद् धुतं दद्याद् इति . तद् उ वा आहुर् हुत एव देयः . देवानां वा एष भागः . को देवानां भागं दातुम् अर्हति . तस्माद् धुत एव देय इति . यादृग् अह वा अस्मिन् लोके ऽन्नं ददाति तादृग् अस्यामुष्मिन् लोके ऽन्नं भवति . एतद् उ ह वा अमुष्मिन् लोके परमम् अन्नाद्यं यत् सोमपीथः . एषा हैवास्य सोमाहुतिर् अमुष्मिन् लोके ऽन्नं भवति . ऋतं सत्यं वदन्तो भक्षयन्ति . ऋतेन हि ते तां सत्येनान्वविन्दन् . ऋतम् अमृतम् इत्य् आह . ऋतेन हि ते तद् अमृतम् अन्वविन्दन् . ओ यि ज्वरा ओयि जूहे ति सामनिधने भवतो वाचस् सत्ये . वाचो हि ते तां सत्येनान्वविन्दन् . तेन हैतेनाथोदिवो गार्ग्य ईजे केशी दार्भ्य ऋजिश्वा वातवात इति . स हर्जिश्वा वातवातो ऽवतताम . तम् उ ह वृषशुष्मेण कुमारेणार्जिश्वनेनाक्ताक्षेणोपनिषेदुर् यद्य् अयम् उ रिष्यत्य् अनेनेदं समापयिष्याम इति . स ह तताम . स ह तान्तः परं लोकं जगाम .
2.158.m: One gives it to the brahman priest, for the brahman alone has a single dakṣiṇā. They say about that: 'Should it be given after being offered into the fire, or without being offered?' They say 'without being offered,' for 'It would be used up if one were to give what has been offered.' But others say: 'It should be given after being offered, for this is the share of the gods. Who is able to give away the share of the gods? Therefore it should be given after being offered.' Whatever kind of food one gives in this world, such food one has in the other world. The highest food in the other world is soma-drinking. This soma libation becomes his food in the other world. They consume it speaking ṛta and satya, for with ṛta and satya they found it. He says 'ṛtam amṛtam' (ṛta is immortality), for with ṛta they found that amṛta. 'O yi jvarā oyi jūhe'—these are the sāma-endings, the truths of speech, for with truth of speech they found it. With this, Athodiva Gārgya sacrificed, as did Keśī Dārbhya and Ṛjiśvā Vātavāta. Ṛjiśvā Vātavāta became weakened. They seated the boy Vṛṣaśuṣma, a descendant of Ṛjiśva, with anointed eyes, beside him, thinking: 'If this one perishes, with this one we shall complete it.' He became weakened. He, being weakened, went to the other world.

2.159.s: tasya ha kalyāṇo loka āsa . sa hovāca tata kasyāyaṃ loka iti . mameti hovāca . atha hānyo lokaḥ kalyāṇatara āsa . kasyo asāv iti . taveti hovāca . sa hovāca tata yat tvaṃ mad bhūyo dadivān asi bhūyas te mad anūktam atha kathaṃ tavāyaṃ loko 'sau mameti . sa hovāca vratopayoddhyo vai kila putrakāsau loka āsa . vratopayodhitara eva nau tvam asi . tasmād ayaṃ mama loko 'sau taveti . gaccheti hovāca saṃ vāvāpsyasi yaṃ vāva kāmaṃ kamitāsi sa te kāmas samardhitā . vakritās tv evāṅgulīḥ kurutād iti . sa ha samāpa . sa ha samāpyovācāpipātra eva syo brāhmaṇānām astv iti . sa hāpipātra eva brāhmaṇānām āsa .
2.159.d: तस्य ह कल्याणो लोक आस . स होवाच तत कस्यायं लोक इति . ममेति होवाच . अथ हान्यो लोकः कल्याणतर आस . कस्यो असाव् इति . तवेति होवाच . स होवाच तत यत् त्वं मद् भूयो ददिवान् असि भूयस् ते मद् अनूक्तम् अथ कथं तवायं लोको ऽसौ ममेति . स होवाच व्रतोपयोद्ध्यो वै किल पुत्रकासौ लोक आस . व्रतोपयोधितर एव नौ त्वम् असि . तस्माद् अयं मम लोको ऽसौ तवेति . गच्छेति होवाच सं वावाप्स्यसि यं वाव कामं कमितासि स ते कामस् समर्धिता . वक्रितास् त्व् एवाङ्गुलीः कुरुताद् इति . स ह समाप . स ह समाप्योवाचापिपात्र एव स्यो ब्राह्मणानाम् अस्त्व् इति . स हापिपात्र एव ब्राह्मणानाम् आस .
2.159.m: His world was beautiful. He said: 'Father, whose world is this?' 'Mine,' he said. Then there was another world, more beautiful. 'Whose is that?' 'Yours,' he said. He said: 'Father, since you have given more than I, and more has been recited for you than for me, how is it that this world is yours and that one is mine?' He said: 'That world, my son, was to be won by observance of vows. You are more accomplished in vow-observance than we. Therefore this world is mine and that one yours.' 'Go,' he said, 'you will obtain it, and whatever desire you shall desire, that desire shall be fulfilled for you. But let him make curved fingers.' He recovered. Having recovered, he said: 'Let there be a drinking vessel for the brāhmaṇas.' And there was indeed a drinking vessel for the brāhmaṇas.

2.160.s: athaiṣa citistomaḥ . prajananakāmo yajeta . tasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bhavanty ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni . saṃvatsara ṛtavaḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ prajananaṃ sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti . tasyobhaye stomā bhavanty ayujaś ca yugmantaś ca . etad vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ yad ubhaye stomāḥ . tad yad daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavataḥ . etat vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ yad ubhe bṛhadrathantare . tad yad daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ prajananaṃ sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti . tasya caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ prajananaṃ sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti . atho āhu svargakāma evainena yajeteti . tasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bhavanty ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni . saṃvatsara ṛtavaḥ . saṃvatsara svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasyordhvā stomā bhavanty ūrdhvo vai svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavata svargye svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsara svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasya caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ .
2.160.d: अथैष चितिस्तोमः . प्रजननकामो यजेत . तस्य पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमा भवन्त्य् ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि . संवत्सर ऋतवः . संवत्सरः प्रजननं स यः प्रजननं स मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्योभये स्तोमा भवन्त्य् अयुजश् च युग्मन्तश् च . एतद् वै दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं यद् उभये स्तोमाः . तद् यद् दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्योभे बृहद्रथन्तरे सामनी भवतः . एतत् वै दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं यद् उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे . तद् यद् दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्य द्वादश स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरः प्रजननं स यः प्रजननं स मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्य चतुर्विंशति स्तुतशस्त्राणि भवन्ति चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरः प्रजननं स यः प्रजननं स मा प्रजनयाद् इति . अथो आहु स्वर्गकाम एवैनेन यजेतेति . तस्य पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमा भवन्त्य् ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि . संवत्सर ऋतवः . संवत्सर स्वर्गो लोक स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्योर्ध्वा स्तोमा भवन्त्य् ऊर्ध्वो वै स्वर्गो लोक स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्योभे बृहद्रथन्तरे सामनी भवत स्वर्ग्ये स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्य द्वादश स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरः . संवत्सर स्वर्गो लोक स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्य चतुर्विंशति स्तुतशस्त्राणि भवन्ति चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः .
2.160.m: Now this is the citistoma. One desiring offspring should sacrifice with it. Its stomas are those of the pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha (six-day period with pṛṣṭha sāmans). The pṛṣṭhas are the seasons. The seasons are the saṃvatsara (year). The saṃvatsara is procreation. 'May that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' Its stomas are of both kinds—odd and even. This is the divine pairing, the procreation, that the stomas are of both kinds. 'May that which is the divine pairing, the procreation, cause me to procreate.'
